flavor: 异域存在们袭击了绯红结社的据点！只有牠们其中的一员能告诉你一切的真相。你必须找到"红手套"或是披著他外皮的怪物，并且追著他到他的世界。
back_flavor: 你终于在红手套矮身进入一道发著光的超次元传送门时追上他。没时间浪费了，这是唯一的机会！你在传送门关闭前迅速跟上他的脚步……
real_text: The Red-Gloved Man gains concealed 1 [per_investigator] and cannot be damaged. Objective - At the end of the round, if each investigator is at the same location as The Red-Gloved Man, they may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

name: 前往塔楼
text: 地点和隐蔽小卡不能被放在[[塔楼]]地点的相邻地点上。 目标 – 找到进入渗透者所在塔楼的方法。如果有调查员进入藐视重力之坡，推进。
back_text:
将每张隐蔽小卡放到一旁，位于场外。从游戏中移除每张在阴影中的残迹之城，以及异界牌堆中剩余的卡牌。
拿取3张残迹之城的隐蔽小卡与1[per_investigator]个诱饵，将其面朝下混洗，并以随机顺序放到藐视重力之坡的周边。
flavor: 在所有已知的现实之外；在只有被遗忘跟遗弃者才知道的次元，异域存在们的世界——怪诞的残迹之城就在这里。一座扭曲、杂乱的建筑矗立在你的视野中，异域天空中翻卷的云雾以那座塔为中心汇聚。
back_flavor: 七道大鍞守卫著塔楼大门，每道锁都来自已经从历史洪流中被抹除的世界。但在大门开启的瞬间你就忘记了它们的存在。门的另一边，一道长得不可思议的阶梯蜿蜒著通向塔顶。强风吹袭，令人头晕目眩，通往塔顶的路看似没有尽头，像是活生生的悖论，一个纠缠盘绕过度的戈耳狄俄斯之结。即使抵达塔顶，你怀疑自己也找不到回家的路。
real_text: Locations and concealed mini-cards cannot be placed adjacent to [[Tower]] locations. Objective - Find a way into the tower where the infiltrator lies in wait. If an investigator enters the Gravity-Defying Climb, advance.

name: 攀登
text: 目标 – 登上巅峰。如果有调查员进入至高之巅，推进。
back_text:
将每张隐蔽小卡放到一旁，位于场外。
将放在一旁的拟态神罚化身敌人与位于至高之巅的戴红手套的男子敌人交换。
拿取拟态神罚化身的隐蔽小卡与2[per_investigator]个诱饵，将其面朝下混洗，并以随机顺序放到至高之巅的周边。
flavor:
当你看著这道无尽的悖论阶梯时，一阵晕眩感将你包围。
只有一条路可走了。
back_flavor: 凭著超人的毅力，你终于爬上最后一道台阶抵达了塔顶。扭曲的绯红云朵在多重次元的天空中相互撞击。通往无数世界的无数大门全都一览无疑；全都毫无防备；全都等著被征服。你赞叹又怜悯地看著异域存在的世界，无数的世界成为牠们的战利品，被蹂躏、抛弃，遗忘在时间的尽头。反正对无垠的宇宙来说，这些世界都只是微不足道的尘埃而已。你的敌人就站在这一切的中心，谱写著人类灭绝的乐章，牠的形体已经几乎找不到红手套的影子。由于缺乏人类的脸，你看不出牠的表情，但依然能感受到牠空洞的凝视。
real_text: Objective - Ascend. If an investigator enters The Towering Vertex, advance.

name: 最后的愚行
text: [action]将你控制的一张密钥从[[稳定]]面翻至[[不稳定]]面：从游戏中移除一张已揭露的诱饵。 目标 – 如果拟态神罚化身被击败，推进。
flavor: 你挥舞著密钥并准备承受冲击。如果你不能expel这个存在并collapse这个dimension，将会变成the end of you all——没有人能有更好的办法。就是现在，你的last chance before there is nothing of you left. nothing of you left nothing(原加密讯息以英文表示)
back_flavor:
可怕的形体倒下了，牠的尖啸刺穿了次元间的帷幕，在你的脑中回荡，将你撕裂成一个个分子。密钥的能量是你还能保持存在的唯一原因，在周围的一切都开始崩解时，密钥是你唯一的寄托。你的后脑一紧，感受到一股拉扯的力量，如同在汹涌潮水中上钩的鱼一样。
接著，黑暗降临。
real_text: [action] Flip a [[Stable]] key you control to its [[Unstable]] side: Remove an exposed decoy from the game. Objective - If Mimetic Nemesis is defeated, advance.

name: 绯红门厅
text: [fast]消耗你控制的一张[[同谋]]支援：移动(到一个连接地点)。
flavor: 如果有人导引，也许这座迷宫不会像看起来这么纷乱。
back_flavor: 绯红结社的秘密据点彰显了他们暗中操控人类的辉煌历史。墙边展示著来自古文明的文物，墙上挂著绯红色的挂毯。画作中的许多名人显贵都身著红色衣物。
real_text: [fast] Exhaust a [[Conspirator]] asset you control: Move (to a connecting location).

name: 绯红门厅
text: 强制 – 在你进入绯红门厅后：你的回合剩余时间里，作为从绯红门厅移动到一个连接地点的额外费用，你必须消耗你控制的一张[[同谋]]支援，或花费一次额外行动。
back_flavor: 绯红结社的秘密据点彰显了他们暗中操控人类的辉煌历史。墙边展示著来自古文明的文物，墙上挂著绯红色的挂毯。画作中的许多名人显贵都身著红色衣物。
real_text: Forced - After you enter Scarlet Halls: For the remainder of your turn, as an additional cost for you to move from Scarlet Halls to a connecting location, you must either exhaust a [[Conspirator]] asset you control or spend an additional action.

name: 峰会议堂
text: [action]消耗你控制的一张[[同谋]]支援：查找你牌堆顶的6张卡牌，找出一张支援，抽取它，将剩下的卡牌洗回你的牌堆。
flavor: 仪式厅放著一张巨型圆桌、用烛光照明。这里就是你接受审判的地方。墙面上有各种奢华的装饰，一应皆是绯红色。
back_flavor: 绯红结社的内部圣殿用于举行古老传统的仪式，散发著温馨但诡异的气氛。
real_text: [action] Exhaust a [[Conspirator]] asset you control: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for an asset, draw it, and shuffle the rest into your deck.

name: 峰会议堂
text: 只要峰会议堂有准备的[[结社]]敌人，位于峰会议堂的每位调查员打出的每张支援的费用提高2点。
flavor: 仪式厅放著一张巨型圆桌、用烛光照明。这里就是你接受审判的地方。墙面上有各种奢华的装饰，一应皆是绯红色。
back_flavor: 绯红结社的内部圣殿用于举行古老传统的仪式，散发著温馨但诡异的气氛。
real_text: While there is a ready [[Coterie]] enemy at Congress Chamber, increase the cost of each asset played by each investigator at Congress Chamber by 2.

name: 结社书库
text: [action]：本轮你打出的下一张支援费用降低2点。你可以消耗你控制的一张[[同谋]]支援以改为将本能力在启动时视为一个[fast]能力，而不是一个[action]能力。
flavor: 一座装满古书的宝库，大堂中保存著无数珍贵的卷轴与尘封的文献。数世纪累积的知识都存放在这，只供结社成员调阅。
back_flavor: 绯红结社的内部圣殿用于举行古老传统的仪式，散发著温馨但诡异的气氛。
real_text: [action]: Reduce the cost of the next asset you play this round by 2. You may exhaust a [[Conspirator]] asset to treat this ability as a [fast] ability instead of an [action] ability for this activation.

name: 结社书库
text: 强制 – 在你调查结社书库的技能检定失败后：最近且有叠加密钥的[[结社]]敌人变换每个其叠加的密钥。
flavor: 一座装满古书的宝库，大堂中保存著无数珍贵的卷轴与尘封的文献。数世纪累积的知识都存放在这，只供结社成员调阅。

real_text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Coterie Library: The nearest [[Coterie]] enemy with an attached key shifts each of their attached keys.

name: 密钥圣柜
text: [reaction]在你成功调查密钥圣柜后：不发现线索，改为选择叠加到你所在地点一位调查员的一个未赋能的密钥。在该密钥上放置一资源(从供应堆拿取)，作为一个赋能；该密钥视为已赋能(如果它被变换，其控制者可以改为花费该赋能，而不是将其翻至[[不稳定]]面)。

Place a resource (from the token pool) on that key, as an empowerment; that key is empowered (if it is shifted, its controller may spend the empowerment instead of flipping it to its [[Unstable]] side).

name: 密钥圣柜
text: 场上每有一个[[不稳定]]密钥，密钥圣柜得到+2隐藏值。
flavor: 有多少密钥被保存在这，被时间遗忘？又有多少被用来当成做恶的工具？
back_flavor: 绯红结社的内部圣殿用于举行古老传统的仪式，散发著温馨但诡异的气氛。
real_text: The Key Reliquary gets +2 shroud for each [[Unstable]] key in play.

name: 百结之塔
text: [reaction]在一个地点被放置到相邻于百结之塔后：移动到该地点(从百结之塔)。
flavor:
所有人都高举著亵渎的象征，
一个被毁灭的世界留下的最后遗物。
 – 维吉尔·格雷，《异域存在之庭》
back_flavor: 一座塔楼矗立在纷乱异域的正中央，从纠结缠绕的城市中拔地而起。它由各式各样的材质混杂而成，你感觉它是无数被遗忘建筑的巨型集合体。异域的雾气像长蛇一般盘绕在它周围破碎、荒芜的山峰上。
real_text: [reaction] After a location is placed adjacent to The Knotted Tower: Move to that location (from The Knotted Tower).

name: 藐视重力之坡
text: 强制 – 在藐视重力之坡周边的隐蔽小卡被揭露时：如果其为…… - ……至高之巅序列中列出的下一张，将其保持揭露并留在场上，你可以揭露另一张隐蔽小卡。 - ……任意其他的隐蔽小卡，将它与其他的隐蔽小卡翻至面朝下(不要混洗)。
back_text: 前往藐视重力之坡的大门被封印且遗忘。作为进入藐视重力之坡的额外费用，在百结之塔的调查员必须作为团队花费4[per_investigator]个线索。
real_text: Forced - When a concealed mini-card around Gravity-Defying Climb is exposed: If it is... - ...the next in the sequence listed on The Towering Vertex, it remains in play and exposed, and you may expose another concealed mini-card. - ...any other mini-card, flip it and each other concealed mini-card facedown (without shuffling them).

name: 至高之巅
text: 强制 – 在至高之巅周边的隐蔽小卡被揭露时：如果其为…… - ……拟态神罚化身的隐蔽小卡，对拟态神罚化身造成3点伤害，然后将所有隐蔽小卡翻回面朝下并混洗。 - ……诱饵，将其保持揭露并留在场上。
back_text: 戴红手套的男子不能被击败。 通往至高之巅的道路既曲折而离奇。调查员若要进入至高之巅，藐视重力之坡周边的隐蔽小卡必须要用以下序列的顺序揭露：第一张，残迹之城(L)；第二张，残迹之城(M)；第三张，残迹之城(R)。
real_text: Forced - When a concealed mini-card around The Towering Vertex is exposed: If it is... - ...the Mimetic Nemesis's mini-card, deal the Mimetic Nemesis 3 damage, then flip all concealed mini-cards facedown and shuffle them facedown. - ...a decoy, it remains in play and exposed.

name: 拟态神罚化身
traits: 古神. 异域存在. 精英
text: 庞大。不能执行趁乱攻击。 拟态神罚化身得到+3[per_investigator]生命值。 强制 – 在拟态神罚化身将要从攻击或玩家卡牌受到1点或更多伤害时：选择并揭示一张隐蔽小卡。如果是诱饵，取消刚才造成的所有伤害(诱饵留在场上，正面朝上)。否则，正常造成该伤害，然后将所有揭示的隐蔽小卡面朝下混洗。
real_text: Massive. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Mimetic Nemesis gets +3 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When Mimetic Nemesis would take 1 or more damage from an attack or player card: Choose and reveal a concealed mini-card. If it is a decoy, cancel all damage just dealt (the decoy remains in play and faceup). Otherwise, the damage is dealt as normal, then flip all revealed mini-cards facedown and shuffle them.

name: 赤红密谋
text: 显现 - 放置1个毁灭标记到一个阴影中的敌人。如果阴影中没有敌人，查找遭遇牌堆和弃牌堆，找出一张带有隐蔽关键词的敌人并抽取该敌人。混洗遭遇牌堆。
flavor: 就在她描述他的穿著时，电话就断了。
real_text: Revelation - Place 1 doom on an enemy in the shadows. If there are no enemies in the shadows, search the encounter deck and discard pile for an enemy with the concealed keyword and draw it. Shuffle the encounter deck.

name: 扭捏现实
text: 祸害。 显现 - 你必须决定(选择一项)：花费1个线索或选择并弃掉你手牌中一半的非弱点卡牌(向上取整)。
flavor: "弗林特，你也看见了吗？"
real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): Spend 1 clue or choose and discard half of the non-weakness cards in your hand (rounded up).

name: 倾盆大雨
text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。你失败且每低于难度一点，你必须受到1点恐惧，或将你的1个线索放到你的所在地点上。
flavor: 牠们大多在下雨时出没，大多数的时候。
real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either take 1 horror, or place 1 of your clues on your location.

name: 结社特使
text:
冷漠。巡逻(最近的有隐蔽小卡的地点，且没有结社特使)
结社特使准备时，位于其所在地点的隐蔽小卡无法被揭露。
[reaction]在你击败结社特使后：查看场上任何一张隐蔽小卡的揭示面。
real_text:
Aloof. Patrol (nearest location with a concealed mini-card and no Coterie Envoy)
While Coterie Envoy is ready, concealed mini-cards at its location cannot be exposed via player card effects.
[reaction] After you defeat Coterie Envoy: Look at the revealed side of any concealed mini-card in play.

name: 一目了然
text: 显现 - 叠加到一个在阴影中且没有叠加一目了然的敌人。如果你不能这么做，一目了然获得涌动。 强制 - 在你揭露被叠加的敌人后：该敌人攻击你并得到+2攻击值，直到本轮结束。丢弃一目了然。
real_text: Revelation - Attach to an enemy in the shadows without a copy of In Plain Sight attached. If you cannot, In Plain Sight gains surge. Forced - After you expose attached enemy: That enemy attacks you and gets +2 fight until the end of the round. Discard In Plain Sight.

name: 黑暗中的刀锋
text: 显现 - 如果你的威胁区域没有黑暗中的刀锋，将其放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。否则，此卡获得涌动。 强制 - 在你揭露一个诱饵后：受到2点伤害。(每轮限制一次。) 强制 - 当你的回合结束时：检定[agility](3)。如果你检定成功，丢弃黑暗中的刀锋。
real_text: Revelation - Put Knives in the Dark into play in your threat area if there is no copy of it in your threat area. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Forced - After you expose a decoy: Take 2 damage. (Limit once per round.) Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, discard Knives in the Dark.

name: 密策
text: 显现 - 如果阴影中没有敌人，密策获得涌动。否则，检定[intellect]或[agility](4)。如果你检定失败，将一个诱饵放到最多隐蔽小卡的地点上，面朝下。并混洗该地点的每张隐蔽小卡。
real_text: Revelation - If there are no enemies in the shadows, Undercover gains surge. Otherwise, test [intellect] or [agility] (4). If you fail, place a decoy at the location with the most concealed mini-cards, flip it facedown, and shuffle each concealed mini-card at that location.

name: 见证阴影
text: 显现 - 将见证阴影放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 在你位于有隐蔽小卡的地点的检定失败后：受到1点恐惧。 [action][action]：丢弃见证阴影。
real_text: Revelation - Put Seeing Shadows into play in your threat area. Forced - After you fail a skill test while at a location with a concealed mini-card: Take 1 horror. [action][action]: Discard Seeing Shadows.

name: 黑暗中的人影
text: 祸害。 显现 - 如果阴影中没有敌人，黑暗中的人影获得涌动。否则，你必须决定(选择一项)： - 每个在阴影中的敌人攻击你。 - 每位调查员失去一次行动。
real_text: Peril. Revelation - If there are no enemies in the shadows, Figures in the Dark gains surge. Otherwise, you must decide (choose one): - Each enemy in the shadows attacks you. - Each investigator loses an action.

name: 结社执行者(A)
text: 隐蔽1。 强制 - 在你揭露一个在阴影中且名称不为结社执行者的敌人后，如果结社执行者在阴影中：其攻击你。
flavor: "你知道该怎么做。"
real_text: Concealed 1. Forced - After you expose an enemy in the shadows not named Coterie Enforcer, if Coterie Enforcer is in the shadows: It attacks you.

name: 结社执行者(B)
text: 隐蔽1。 强制 - 在你揭露一个在阴影中且名称不为结社执行者的敌人后，如果结社执行者在阴影中：其攻击你。
flavor: "你知道该怎么做。"
real_text: Concealed 1. Forced - After you expose an enemy in the shadows not named Coterie Enforcer, if Coterie Enforcer is in the shadows: It attacks you.

name: 结社刺客(A)
text: 隐蔽1。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时，如果结社刺客在阴影中：其攻击每位所在地点有隐蔽小卡的调查员。
flavor: 不择手段。
real_text: Concealed 1. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Coterie Assassin is in the shadows: It attacks each investigator at each location with 1 or more concealed mini-cards.

name: 结社刺客(B)
text: 隐蔽1。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时，如果结社刺客在阴影中：其攻击每位所在地点有隐蔽小卡的调查员。
flavor: 不择手段。
real_text: Concealed 1. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Coterie Assassin is in the shadows: It attacks each investigator at each location with 1 or more concealed mini-cards.

name: 迅速撤离
text: 显现 - 如果场上没有[[结社]]敌人，迅速撤离获得涌动。否则，找出最近的[[结社]]敌人并检定[agility](3)。如果你检定失败，该敌人攻击你。如果你检定失败且该敌人不在阴影中，结算其隐蔽关键词(如果可能)。
real_text: Revelation - If there are no [[Coterie]] enemies in play, Swift Retreat gains surge. Otherwise, find the nearest [[Coterie]] enemy and test [agility] (3). If you fail, that enemy attacks you. If you fail and that enemy is not in the shadows, resolve its concealed keyword (if able).

name: 赤红约束
text: 显现 - 如果场上没有[[结社]]敌人，赤红约束获得涌动。否则，将其叠加到印刷生命值最高的[[结社]]敌人。 被叠加的敌人得到+1生命值、+1躲避值、+1伤害值、+1恐惧值。 [action]：将你控制的一张密钥从[[稳定]]面翻至[[不稳定]]面。然后，丢弃赤红约束。位于任何地点的调查员都可以触发此能力。
real_text: Revelation - If there are no [[Coterie]] enemies in play, Bound in Red gains surge. Otherwise, attach it to the [[Coterie]] enemy with the highest printed health. Attached enemy gets +1 fight, +1 evade, +1 damage, and +1 horror. [action]: Flip a [[Stable]] key you control to its [[Unstable]] side. Then, discard Bound in Red. An investigator at any location may trigger this ability.

name: 密钥充能
text: 涌动。 显现 - 每个[[结社]]敌人变换叠加在其上的每个密钥。
flavor:
我的视线在他们摆弄那个充满恶魔力量的工具时逐渐模糊……
- 维吉尔·格雷，《异域存在之庭》
real_text: Surge. Revelation - Each [[Coterie]] enemy shifts each key attached to it.

name: 超因果存在
text: 猎手。 强制 - 在超因果存在与你交战时：查看你牌堆顶的卡牌。如果该卡牌不是弱点，将其放到一旁，位于场外，作为空洞卡牌。
flavor: 档案 #AT-151/目标看似能超越或扭曲物理法则，不具质量。能够将碰触的物质"空洞化"(参见档案 #AV-245)。无捕捉的可能性。
real_text: Hunter. Forced - When Paracausal Entity engages you: Look at the top card of your deck. If it is not a weakness, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.

name: 天启末日之兆
text: 强制 - 在天启末日之兆入场时：每位调查员选择一张其控制在手牌或游戏区域的非弱点卡牌，将其放到一旁，位于场外，作为空洞卡牌。 [reaction]在天启末日之兆被击败时：不将其加入胜利牌区，改为将其弃掉并选择最多3张放在一旁的空洞卡牌。将它们加入其所有者的手牌中。
real_text: Forced - When Apocalyptic Presage enters play: Each investigator chooses a non-weakness card they control in their hand or play area and sets it aside, out of play, as a hollow. [reaction] When Apocalyptic Presage is defeated: Instead of adding it to the victory display, discard it and choose up to 3 set-aside hollows. Add them to their owners' hands.

name: 物质虚像
text: 显现 - 每张你拥有的放在一旁的空洞卡牌，如果你的游戏区域和/或手牌有1张或更多同名的卡牌，将那些卡牌弃掉并受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。如果此效果没有弃掉任何卡牌，选择一张你控制在你手牌或游戏区域的非弱点卡牌，将其放到一旁，位于场外，作为空洞卡牌。
flavor: 档案 #AT-245，补充/未观测到任何能量转换。被空洞吞噬的物质去哪了？
real_text: Revelation - For each set-aside hollow you own, if there are 1 or more copies of that hollow in your play area and/or hand, discard those copies and take 1 damage and 1 horror. If no cards are discarded by this effect, choose a non-weakness card you control in your hand or play area and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.

name: 超凡拟态
text: 冷漠。猎手。 强制 - 如果超凡拟态准备，在其所在地点的调查员打出、投入或触发与放在一旁空洞卡牌同名卡牌的能力时：其攻击该调查员。
flavor: 档案 #AV-261，补充/目标似乎恢复了正常的物质状态。
real_text: Aloof. Hunter. Forced - If Otherworldly Mimic is ready, when an investigator at its location plays, commits, or triggers an ability on a copy of a set-aside hollow: It attacks that investigator.

name: 记忆变体
text: 显现 - 将记忆变体放置入场，放到密谋牌堆旁。 强制 - 在一张事件被打出后：不将其弃掉，改为将其放到一旁，位于场外，作为空洞卡牌。 [action]：检定[willpower](4)。如果你检定成功，丢弃记忆变体。任何调查员都可以触发此能力。
real_text: Revelation - Put Memory Variant into play next to the agenda deck. Forced - After an event is played: Instead of discarding it, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow. [action]: Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, discard Memory Variant. Any investigator may trigger this ability.

name: 遗失的秘密
text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。你失败且每低于难度一点，选择一张你的非弱点手牌，将其放到一旁，位于场外，作为空洞卡牌。如果你成功并超出难度2点或更多，你可以受到1点恐惧并选择一张放在一旁的空洞卡牌，将其加入拥有者的手牌中。
real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, choose a non-weakness card in your hand and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow. If you succeed by 2 or more, you may take 1 horror to choose a set-aside hollow and add it to its owner's hand.

name: 范式抹除者
text: 冷漠。猎手。 强制 - 在你位于范式抹除者所在地点结束回合后：查看你牌堆顶的卡牌。如果该卡牌不是弱点，将其放到一旁，位于场外，作为空洞卡牌。然后，如果你拥有3张或更多放在一旁的空洞卡牌，范式抹除者攻击你。
real_text: Aloof. Hunter. Forced - After you end your turn at Paradigm Effacer's location: Look at the top card of your deck. If it is not a weakness, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow. Then, if you own 3 or more set-aside hollows, Paradigm Effacer attacks you.

name: 事物逆位
text: 显现 - 叠加到一个没有叠加事物逆位的[[异域存在]]敌人。如果你不能这么做，事物逆位获得涌动。 被叠加的敌人失去冷漠，获得反击，并得到+1攻击值和+1躲避值。 强制 - 在成功躲避被叠加敌人后：丢弃事物逆位，并抽取1张你拥有的放在一旁的空洞卡牌。
real_text: Revelation - Attach to an [[Outsider]] enemy without a copy of Matter Inversion attached. If you cannot, Matter Inversion gains surge. Attached enemy loses aloof, gains retaliate, and gets +1 fight and +1 evade. Forced - After attached enemy is successfully evaded: Discard Matter Inversion and draw 1 of your set-aside hollows.

name: 犹格斯星的使者
text: 隐蔽2。猎手。庞大。 强制 - 在你发现有隐蔽小卡的地点的一个线索后，如果犹格斯星的使者在阴影中：其攻击你。
real_text: Concealed 2. Hunter. Massive. Forced - After you discover a clue at a location with 1 or more concealed mini-cards, if Emissary from Yuggoth is in the shadows: It attacks you.

name: 阴晦日蚀
text: 显现 - 将阴晦日蚀放置入场，放到密谋牌堆旁。 每轮中每位调查员不能揭露多于1张隐蔽小卡。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：丢弃场上的1张阴晦日蚀。(每轮最多一次。)
real_text: Revelation - Put Tenebrous Eclipse into play next to the agenda deck. No more than 1 concealed mini-card can be exposed by each investigator each round. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard 1 copy of Tenebrous Eclipse from play. (Max once per round.)

name: 裂解空间
text: 显现 - 将裂解空间叠加到你所在地点并检定[agility](3)。如果你检定失败，你所在地点每有一张叠加的[[巫术]]诡计，受到1点伤害。在检定结束后，如果场上有正好3张裂解空间，将其全数丢弃。
real_text: Revelation - Attach Splintered Space to your location and test [agility] (3). If you fail, take 1 damage for each [[Hex]] treachery attached to your location. After this test ends, if there are exactly 3 copies of Splintered Space in play, discard them.

name: 出格之物
text: 显现 - 将出格之物叠加到你所在地点并检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定失败，你所在地点每有一张叠加的[[巫术]]诡计，受到1点恐惧。在检定结束后，如果场上有正好3张出格之物，将其全数丢弃。
real_text: Revelation - Attach Beyond the Pale to your location and test [willpower] (3). If you fail, take 1 horror for each [[Hex]] treachery attached to your location. After this test ends, if there are exactly 3 copies of Beyond the Pale in play, discard them.

name: 歪曲现实
text: 显现 - 叠加到你所在地点。 强制 - 在你位于叠加地点结束回合后：选择一张你的非弱点手牌，将其放到一旁，位于场外，作为空洞卡牌。 [action][action]：丢弃歪曲现实。
real_text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Forced - After you end your turn at attached location: Choose a non-weakness card in your hand and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow. [action][action]: Discard Warped Reality.

name: 超乎理解的接触
text: 显现 - 在你控制的资源印刷数值最高的支援上放置1个毁灭标记。如果此效果没有放置任何毁灭标记，超乎理解的接触获得涌动。
flavor:
我感觉到内心深处传来令人好奇的呢喃，好像在呼唤我到别的地方。
- 维吉尔·格雷，《异域存在之庭》
real_text: Revelation - Place 1 doom on the asset you control with the highest printed resource cost. If no doom was placed by this effect, Touch of the Beyond gains surge.

name: 强迫
text: 显现 - 将强迫放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 在你回合开始时：从混乱袋中随机抽出一个混乱标记。如果是[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]标记，如果可能，本回合期间你第一个执行的行动必须是以下能力。 [action][action]：丢弃强迫。
real_text: Revelation - Put Compulsion into play in your threat area. Forced - When your turn begins: Reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag. If it is a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] token, the first action you perform during this turn must be the below ability, if able. [action][action]: Discard Compulsion.

name: 扭曲论证
text: 显现 - 将扭曲论证放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 你不能连续执行两次相同种类的行动。(这些种类包括启动、交战、躲避、战斗、调查、移动、打出卡牌、获得资源与抽牌。) 强制 - 当你的回合结束时：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，丢弃扭曲论证。
real_text: Revelation - Put Distorted Reasoning into play in your threat area. You cannot perform the same type of action twice in a row. (Types include activate, engage, evade, fight, investigate, move, play, resource, and draw.) Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Distorted Reasoning.

name: 无际之径
text: 位于无际之径的每张隐蔽小卡的攻击或躲避难度增加2。 [action]花费X资源：选择一张位于X次连接的地点上的隐蔽小卡。查看其揭示面(不可揭露)。(团队每场游戏限制一次)。
back_text: 隐蔽1。 强制 - 在你揭露此地点时： - 如果其在阴影中的左边位置，受到1点伤害。 - 如果其在阴影中的右边位置，受到1点恐惧。
real_text: Increase the difficulty to fight or evade each concealed mini-card at Rambling Route by 2. [action] Spend X resources: Choose a concealed mini-card adjacent to a location X connections away. Look at its revealed side (without exposing it). (Group limit once per game.)

name: 无际之径
text: 位于无际之径的每张隐蔽小卡的攻击或躲避难度增加2。 [action]花费X资源：选择一张位于X次连接的地点上的隐蔽小卡。查看其揭示面(不可揭露)。(团队每场游戏限制一次)。
back_text: 隐蔽1。 强制 - 在你揭露此地点时： - 如果其在阴影中的左边位置，失去2资源。 - 如果其在阴影中的中间位置，失去一次行动。
real_text: Increase the difficulty to fight or evade each concealed mini-card at Rambling Route by 2. [action] Spend X resources: Choose a concealed mini-card adjacent to a location X connections away. Look at its revealed side (without exposing it). (Group limit once per game.)

name: 无际之径
text: 位于无际之径的每张隐蔽小卡的攻击或躲避难度增加2。 [action]花费X资源：选择一张位于X次连接的地点上的隐蔽小卡。查看其揭示面(不可揭露)。(团队每场游戏限制一次)。
back_text: 隐蔽1。 强制 - 在你揭露此地点时： - 如果其在阴影中的中间位置，选择一张你的非弱点手牌，将其放到一旁，位于场外，作为空洞卡牌。 - 如果其在阴影中的右边位置，选择一张你控制的支援，将其放到一旁，位于场外，作为空洞卡牌。
real_text: Increase the difficulty to fight or evade each concealed mini-card at Rambling Route by 2. [action] Spend X resources: Choose a concealed mini-card adjacent to a location X connections away. Look at its revealed side (without exposing it). (Group limit once per game.)

name: 异星边境
text: 强制 - 在你从异星边境移动至其左侧或右侧的连接地点时，检定[agility](5)。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害。 [action]受到1点恐惧：查看阴影中的一个地点的揭示面，或是异界牌堆顶的卡牌。(团队每场游戏限制一次)。
back_text: 隐蔽1。 强制 - 在你揭露此地点时： - 如果其在阴影中的左边位置，受到1点伤害。 - 如果其在阴影中的右边位置，受到1点恐惧。
real_text: Forced - When you move from Alien Frontier to a connecting location to its left or right, test [agility] (5). If you fail, take 2 damage. [action] Take 1 horror: Look at the revealed side of either a location in the shadows, or the top card of the Otherworld deck. (Group limit once per game.)

name: 异星边境
text: 强制 - 在你从异星边境移动至其上方或下方的连接地点时，检定[agility](5)。如果你检定失败，受到2点伤害。 [action]受到1点恐惧：查看阴影中的一个地点的揭示面，或是异界牌堆顶的卡牌。(团队每场游戏限制一次)。
back_text: 隐蔽1。 强制 - 在你揭露此地点时： - 如果其在阴影中的左边位置，失去2资源。 - 如果其在阴影中的中间位置，失去一次行动。
real_text: Forced - When you move from Alien Frontier to a connecting location above or below it, test [agility] (5). If you fail, take 2 damage. [action] Take 1 horror: Look at the revealed side of either a location in the shadows, or the top card of the Otherworld deck. (Group limit once per game.)

name: 拟像异林

name: "灰堆"皮特
text:
开始游戏时，将皮特的吉他放置入场。
[reaction]在你拥有的一张叠加到冒险卡的卡牌将被丢弃时：改为将其加入你的手牌。(每轮限制一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+1。选择你拥有的一张叠加到冒险卡的卡牌。你可以将所选卡牌返回你的手牌。
back_text: 卡牌张数：30。 牌组构建选项：求生者([survivor])等级0-3，[[临时制品]]和[[策略]]卡牌等级0-4，中立卡牌等级0-5，最多5张其他守护者([guardian])卡牌等级0。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：杜克、噩梦来袭、1张随机基础弱点。
flavor: "来吧，伙计。我们该工作了。"
back_flavor: "灰堆"皮特流浪到哪里，就睡在哪里，无论是田野、火车还是谷仓。他已经习惯了，更何况还有他心爱的狗狗——杜克，还有随身的老吉他陪伴。有时候皮特进入梦乡时，会看到一个扭曲的未知场所，那里到处都是可怕的生物。当被噩梦惊醒后，那真实的感受令他坚信世界上有人被困在了那里。皮特已经漫无目的地流浪了很久，过著简单的生活。但是他内心的正义感无法容忍自己的漠视， 现在他要去拯救那个可怜虫。

[elder_sign] effect: +1. Choose a card you own attached to a scenario card. You may return the chosen card to your hand.

name: 个体代号5U-21
text: 你以饥肠辘辘(饥饿可控)在场上开始游戏。 在每个补给阶段期间,抽取额外1张卡牌并吞噬你手牌中一张非弱点玩家卡牌。 [fast]: 吞噬你所在地点的一位调查员控制的一张非剧情卡牌。(每轮仅限一次。) [elder_sign] effect: +2. 效果:+2。本次检定结束后,你可以将一张被吞噬的卡牌加入其所有者的手牌。
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数: 50. 牌库构筑选项: 中立卡牌等级0-5,任意职阶的等级0卡牌。 牌库构筑需求 (不计入卡牌张数): 饥肠辘辘、3张反刍、3张现实溶蚀、2张随机基础弱点。 牌库构筑限制: 除剧情及署名永久卡牌之外,没有其他永久卡牌。 附加需求: 你的牌库中必须至少包括来自每种职阶([guardian], [seeker], [rogue], [mystic], 和 [survivor])的卡牌各7张。 附加升级选项: 在每场冒险结束之后。将每张你吞噬的(在饥肠辘辘底下及放在一边的)卡牌按职阶分开。在本剧本的下一场冒险开始前,你可以花费经验值来购买或升级被吞噬的卡牌最多的职阶(如果出现平局,则任选其中一个)中任意数量、任意等级的卡牌。
flavor: "It can be arranged. It's just a matter of acceptable terms."

(If the chaos token revealed is not listed, or if the listed aspect cannot be devoured, reveal a new chaos token and consult the list again.) - [elder_sign]: ...a non-[[Elite]] enemy or treachery, at your location and worth no victory points. - +1: ...the top card of each investigator's discard pile. - 0: ...the top card of each investigator's deck. - -1: ...1 card at random from your hand. - -2: ...a non-story, non-weakness asset controlled by an investigator at your location. - -3: ...a player card attached to your location, or attached to an encounter card at your location. - -4: ...the top 2 cards of each investigator's deck. - -5: ...-3 cards of your choice from your hand.

name: 联邦探员
text: 你得到全技能值+1。 [reaction] 在你技能检定将要失败并正好低于难度1点时:从你手牌中打出联邦探员。(此效果可能导致检定成功。) 强制 – 本阶段结束时:将联邦探员返回你的手牌。
pack_name: The Blob That Ate Everything ELSE!
real_text: You get +1 to all skills. [reaction] When you would fail a skill test by exactly 1: Play G-Men from your hand. (This may cause the test to succeed.) Forced – At the end of the phase: Return G-Men to your hand.

name: 腐蚀云雾
text: 使用(3充能)。 [action] 花费1充能: 躲避。 如果你成功,自动躲避你所在地点的所有敌人,并对其各造成1点伤害。如果本次检定期间抽出了 [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], 或 [auto_fail] 符号,你所在地点的每位调查员受到1点伤害并失去1个行动。
pack_name: The Blob That Ate Everything ELSE!
real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Evade. If you succeed, automatically evade each enemy at your location and deal 1 damage to each of them. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this test, each investigator at your location takes 1 damage and loses 1 action.

name: 外星器具
text: [action]: 调查。 选择你所在地点的一个被消耗的[[生物]]或[[怪物]]敌人。本次技能检定的难度等于所选敌人的躲避值。如果你成功,对所选敌人造成1点伤害并发现你所在地点的额外1个线索。
pack_name: The Blob That Ate Everything ELSE!
real_text: [action]: Investigate. Choose an exhausted [[Creature]] or [[Monster]] enemy at your location. The difficulty of this skill test is equal to the chosen enemy’s evade value. If you succeed, deal 1 damage to the chosen enemy and discover 1 additional clue at your location.

name: 化学设备
traits: 道具. 工具. 科学
text: [action]消耗化学设备：调查。如果你…… - ……失败且低于难度正好2点，丢弃化学设备。 - ……成功且正好等于难度，获得2资源。 - ……成功且高于难度正好2点，抽取1张卡牌。 - ……成功且高于难度正好4点，发现你所在地点的额外1个线索。
pack_name: 铁杉谷盛宴调查员扩充
real_text: [action] Exhaust Chemistry Set: Investigate. If you... - ...fail by exactly 2, discard Chemistry Set. - ...succeed by exactly 0, gain 2 resources. - ...succeed by exactly 2, draw 1 card. - ...succeed by exactly 4, discover 1 additional clue at your location.

name: 医生查理斯‧威斯特三世
text:
你拥有额外1个手部槽位，只能用来携带[[工具]]支援卡。
[reaction]在你调查成功且超过难度正好1点或3点后，消耗医生查理斯‧威斯特三世：对你所在地点的1名敌人造成1点伤害。
pack_name: 铁杉谷盛宴调查员扩充
real_text:
You have 1 additional hand slot, which can only be used to hold a [[Tool]] asset.
[reaction] After you successfully investigate by exactly 1 or 3, exhaust Dr. Charles West III: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.

name: 显微镜
traits: 道具. 工具. 科学
text: [reaction]在你所在地点的敌人被成功躲避或被击败后，消耗显微镜：放置1资源在显微镜上，作为证据。 [action][action]：调查。显微镜上每有一证据，这次调查中你+1[intellect](最多+3[intellect])。如果你成功，你可以花费最多2证据来发现你所在地点等同该花费量的额外线索。
pack_name: 铁杉谷盛宴调查员扩充
real_text: [reaction] After an enemy at your location is successfully evaded or defeated, exhaust Microscope: Place 1 resource on Microscope, as evidence. [action] [action]: Investigate. You get +1 [intellect] for this investigation for each evidence on Microscope (max +3 [intellect]). If you succeed, you may spend up to 2 evidence to discover that many additional clues at your location.

name: 暴食菌株
traits: 生物. 怪物. 植物. 科学
text:
每副牌组限制1张。
[action]：在你的绑定卡牌中查找诡异生长，并将其加入你的手牌。
[action]如果暴食菌株上有至少3生长：移动每个生长到你的资源池，作为资源。在你的冒险日志里纪录"你定义了一个新物种。"
pack_name: 铁杉谷盛宴调查员扩充
real_text:
Limit 1 per deck.
[action]: Search your bonded cards for Uncanny Growth and add it to your hand.
[action] If Ravenous Myconid has 3 or more growth on it: Move each growth to your resource pool, as resources. Record in your Campaign Log that "you have classified a new species."

name: 诡异生长
text: 绑定(暴食菌株)。 调查。在这次检定结算后，你每成功且超过难度1点，放置1资源在暴食菌株上，作为生长。将诡异生长放在一边，位于场外。如果你失败，将诡异生长返回你的手牌。
pack_name: 铁杉谷盛宴调查员扩充
real_text: Bonded (Ravenous Myconid). Investigate. After this test resolves, place 1 resource on Ravenous Myconid, as growth, for each point you succeed by. Set Uncanny Growth aside, out of play. If you fail, return Uncanny Growth to your hand.

name: 资金充裕
text: 你控制[[科学]]或[[工具]]支援卡的时候，资金充裕获得[wild](你控制3个以上的[[科学]]和/或[[工具]]支援卡的时候，资金充裕改为获得[wild][wild])。
flavor: 花在这个研究上的每分钱都值得。
pack_name: 铁杉谷盛宴调查员扩充
real_text: While you control a [[Science]] or [[Tool]] asset, Well-Funded gains [wild] (while you control 3 or more [[Science]] and/or [[Tool]] assets, Well-Funded gains [wild] [wild], instead).

name: "我会还你的！"
text:
快速。只能在你的回合期间打出。
选择你所在地点的一位调查员。将该调查员资源池的所有资源移动到你的资源池。当本轮结束时，将你资源池的所有资源移动到该调查员的资源池。
pack_name: 铁杉谷盛宴调查员扩充
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Choose another investigator at your location. Move all resources from that investigator's resource pool to your resource pool. At the end of the round, move all resources from your resource pool to that investigator's resource pool.

name: 干草叉
traits: 道具. 工具. 武器. 近战
text: [action]：攻击。这次攻击中你+1[combat]并造成+2伤害。如果这次攻击成功，失去对干草叉的控制，并将其叠加到你所在地点。你所在地点获得： "[action]：控制干草叉。位于干草叉所在地点的任何调查员均可触发此能力。"
pack_name: 铁杉谷盛宴调查员扩充
real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] and deal +2 damage for this attack. If this attack is successful, lose control of Pitchfork and attach it to your location. Attached location gains: "[action]: Take control of Pitchfork. Any investigator at Pitchfork's location may trigger this ability."

name: 麻雀面具
traits: 道具. 守护. 面具
text:
每位调查员限制1[[面具]]。
使用(2贡品)。在你受到至少1点伤害和/或恐惧后，补充1贡品。
[fast]花费1供品：这次技能检定中你+2[willpower]或+2[agility]。(每次检定限制一次。)
pack_name: 铁杉谷盛宴调查员扩充
real_text:
Limit 1 [[Mask]] per investigator.
Uses (2 offerings). Replenish 1 of these offerings after you take 1 or more damage and/or horror.
[fast] Spend 1 offering: You get +2 [willpower] or +2 [agility] for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)

name: 物尽其用
text: 选择你弃牌堆中的一张[[武器]]或[[工具]]支援卡。结算该支援卡上的一个[action]能力，忽略所有费用(包含其[action]费用)。 在此效果结算后，将所选支援卡混洗入你的牌堆。 打出此卡牌不会引起趁乱攻击。
pack_name: 铁杉谷盛宴调查员扩充
real_text: Choose a [[Weapon]] or [[Tool]] asset in your discard pile. Resolve an [action] ability on that asset, ignoring all costs (including its [action] cost). After this effect resolves, shuffle the chosen asset into your deck. Playing this card does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: 拖延时间
text: 谈判。选择你所在地点的一名敌人。检定[willpower](X)，其中X为所选敌人的攻击值或躲避值，取其中较低的数值。如果你成功，消耗所选敌人(但不与其解除交战). 如果其非[[精英]]，其在下次补给阶段期间不准备。如果你失败，将拖延时间返回你的手牌。
pack_name: 铁杉谷盛宴调查员扩充
real_text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location. Test [willpower] (X), where X is the chosen enemy's fight or evade value, whichever is lower. If you succeed, exhaust the chosen enemy (but do not disengage from it). If it is non-[[Elite]], it does not ready during the next upkeep phase. If you fail, return Stall for Time to your hand.

name: 对的时间，错的地点
text:
作为打出对的时间，错的地点的额外费用，花费一个行动。
将你调查员上的最多5点伤害和/或恐惧移动到你所在地点调查员控制的支援卡上。每有一张支援卡因此效果被击败，抽取1张卡牌。将对的时间，错的地点从游戏中移除。
pack_name: 铁杉谷盛宴调查员扩充
real_text:
As an additional cost to play Wrong Place, Right Time, spend an action.
Move up to 5 damage and/or horror from your investigator to assets controlled by investigators at your location. For each asset defeated by this effect, draw 1 card. Remove Wrong Place, Right Time from the game.

name: 百步穿杨
text:
你可以投入百步穿杨到你所在地点或连接地点对敌人的攻击或躲避检定。
如果这次检定成功，对该敌人造成1点伤害。
pack_name: 铁杉谷盛宴调查员扩充
real_text:
You may commit Long Shot to a fight or evasion test against an enemy at your location or a connecting location.
If this test is successful, deal 1 damage to that enemy.

name: 吉姆·卡尔弗
text:
[reaction]在你执行的技能检定期间，抽出至少1个[skull]或[curse]标记后：在一个你控制的支援上补充1充能。(每轮限制一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+2。你可以改为将此标记视为[skull]或[curse]标记。
back_text: 卡牌张数：30。 牌组构建选项：潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-3，[[法术]]和[[诅咒萦绕]]卡牌等级0-4，中立卡牌等级0-5，最多5张其它求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：吉姆的小号、最后的狂想曲、彼端、1张随机基础弱点。 灵魂牌组张数：10。 灵魂牌组构建选项：9张不同的任意职阶[[盟友]]支援等级0–2，复仇形影。 灵魂牌组指示：将“灵魂牌堆”和你的牌堆分别混洗，将灵魂牌堆面朝下放在彼端支援旁。此牌堆可以使用你未花费的经验值分别升级。
flavor: “我知道我能让亡者起舞。”
back_flavor: 自从吉姆拿起爸爸的小号开始，爵士乐就只会带来麻烦。但亡者显然非常喜欢他的演奏，所以吉姆没打算放弃。
real_text:
[reaction] After you reveal 1 or more [skull] or [curse] tokens during a skill test you are performing: Replenish 1 charge on an asset you control. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may treat this token as if it were a [skull] or [curse] token instead.

name: 吉姆的小号
traits: 道具. 乐器. 遗物
text:
吉姆·卡尔弗牌组专用。进阶。
[reaction]在你执行的技能检定期间，抽出[skull]或[curse]标记时，消耗吉姆的小号：治愈你所在地点或连接地点上每位调查员和[[盟友]]支援的1点恐惧。
real_text:
Jim Culver deck only. Advanced.
[reaction] When a [skull] or [curse] token is revealed during a skill test you are performing, exhaust Jim's Trumpet: Heal 1 horror from each investigator and [[Ally]] asset at your location or a connecting location.

name: 最后的狂想曲
text: 进阶。 显现 - 从混乱袋中抽取5个混乱标记。每抽出1个非[elder_sign]、非[bless]的符号标记，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。
flavor: 当亡者开始谈论他们害怕的事情时，就是该仔细聆听的时候了。
real_text: Advanced. Revelation - Reveal 5 chaos tokens from the chaos bag. For each non-[elder_sign], non-[bless] symbol token revealed, take 1 damage and 1 horror.

name: 彼端
text: 吉姆·卡尔弗牌组专用。永久。 每个叠加的灵魂失去所有印刷的属性并获得[[灵怪]]属性。在伤害或恐惧将要被放到叠加的灵魂上时，必须改为将其放到吉姆·卡尔弗上。 强制 – 在你的回合开始时：将灵魂牌堆最顶部的卡牌叠加到彼端，作为灵魂。如果叠加了4个或更多的灵魂，将此卡牌翻面并结算其文本。
real_text: Jim Culver deck only. Permanent. Each attached spirit loses all printed traits and gains the [[Geist]] trait. When damage/horror would be placed on an attached spirit, it must be placed on Jim Culver, instead. Forced – When your turn begins: Attach the top card of the spirit deck to The Beyond, as a spirit. If 4 or more spirits are attached, flip this card and resolve its text.

name: 彼端
text:
强制 – 对于每张叠加到彼端的非弱点灵魂，依次选择一张并从混乱袋随机抽出1个标记。如果是…… - ……[elder_sign]标记：你可以治愈1点恐惧，或将灵魂牌堆最顶部的卡牌叠加到彼端，作为灵魂。(在结算此效果后，不用再对此灵魂抽出标记。) - ……[auto_fail]标记：丢弃此灵魂。受到1点直接伤害或恐惧。 - ……[skull]标记：丢弃此灵魂。治愈1点恐惧。 - ……[cultist]、[elder_thing]、[tablet]或[curse]标记：你必须丢弃此灵魂或受到1点直接伤害。 - ……任何其他标记：丢弃此灵魂。 将此卡牌翻回到其支援面。
提示：叠加到彼端的灵魂在场上，但只保留他们的名字和文字框。灵魂不占用槽位、没有生命值或神智值。在一个独特的灵魂被叠加到彼端时，弃掉其他所有已经在场上的同名支援。灵魂被丢弃时放置到灵魂牌堆的底部。
real_text:
Forced – One at a time, choose each non-weakness spirit attached to The Beyond and reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If it is... - ... an [elder_sign] token: You may either heal 1 horror, or attach the top card of the spirit deck to The Beyond, as a spirit. (Do not reveal tokens for the spirit you attach after resolving this effect.) - ... an [auto_fail] token: Discard this spirit. Take 1 direct damage/horror. - ...a [skull] token: Discard this spirit. Heal 1 horror. - ...a [cultist], [elder_thing], [tablet], or [curse] token: You must either discard this spirit or take 1 direct damage. - ...any other token: Discard this spirit. Flip this card back to its asset side.
Reminder: Spirits attached to The Beyond are in play but only retain their names and text boxes. Spirits do not take up slots and do not have health or sanity values. When a unique spirit is attached to The Beyond, any other asset that shares its name and is already in play is discarded. Spirits are always discarded to the bottom of the spirit deck.

name: 复仇形影
text: 猎手。猎物 – 仅限吉姆·卡尔弗。 此敌人被叠加到彼端时，你可以攻击或躲避此敌人(如同其与你交战)。如果你成功，将其丢弃。如果你失败，生成该敌人并与你交战。 强制 – 在你透过其强制效果将一个灵魂叠加到彼端时：复仇形影攻击你(即使其不在你的地点)。
real_text: Hunter. Prey – Jim Culver only. You may fight or evade this enemy while it is attached to The Beyond (as if it were engaged with you). If you succeed, discard it. If you fail, spawn it engaged with you. Forced – When you attach a spirit to The Beyond via its forced effect: Vengeful Shade attacks you (even if it is not at your location).

name: 安魂镇息
text:
简单 / 普通
[skull]：-X。X等于胜利牌区内未了之事的数量+1。
[cultist]：-X。X等于叠加到彼端的卡牌数量。
[tablet]：-X。X等于场上[[幽灵]]地点的数量。
[elder_thing]：-2。如果你所在地点有[[灵怪]]敌人，再抽一个标记。
back_text:
困难 / 专家
[skull]：-X。X等于胜利牌区内未了之事的数量+2。
[cultist]：-X。X等于叠加到彼端的卡牌数量的两倍。
[tablet]：-X。X等于场上[[幽灵]]地点数量的两倍。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你所在地点有[[灵怪]]敌人，你自动失败。
real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is 1 more than the number of copies of Unfinished Business in the victory display.
[cultist]: -X. X is the number of cards attached to The Beyond.
[tablet]: -X. X is the number of [[Spectral]] locations in play.
[elder_thing]: -2. If there is a [[Geist]] enemy at your location, reveal another token.

name: 迷雾聚集
text: 强制 – 在敌军阶段开始时：尚·德弗罗的地点上每有一个准备的饥饿的灵魂，对他造成1点伤害。 强制 – 如果吉姆·卡尔弗被击败：推进场景。 [action]以团队为单位花费2[per_investigator]个线索：谈判。你放逐了一个灵魂。丢弃灵魂牌堆最顶部的卡牌。(提示：将异端者从彼端抽取出来，并在尚的帮助下召唤它们！)
back_text: 放置1个恐惧到冒险辅助卡上的心灵扰动(Spiritual Disturbance)下。如果冒险辅助卡上有4个恐惧。每位未退场的调查员被击败，并受到1点精神创伤。(→R2) 否则(如果冒险辅助卡上的恐惧不超过3个)，执行以下： - 在每个地点上放置线索，直到其上有1[per_investigator]个线索。 - 将每个地点(除了尚·德弗罗的地点)翻到其非[[幽灵]]面。 将此密谋翻回正面。
flavor: 绞刑者山丘上充斥著魑魅魍魉。
back_flavor: 鬼灵作祟的山丘上吹来一阵冷风，冰寒刺骨。灵魂们越来越不安宁了。
real_text: Forced – When the enemy phase begins: Deal 1 damage to Jean Devereux for each ready Ravenous Spirit at his location. Forced – If Jim Culver is defeated: Advance the act. [action] Spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Parley. You banish a spirit. Discard the top card of the Spirit deck. (Hint: Draw Heretics out of the Beyond and summon them with Jean’s help!)

name: 安魂镇息
text: [fast]消耗吉姆的小号，或以团队为单位花费1[per_investigator]个线索：选择一个敌人，朝吉姆·卡尔弗的地点移动一次。 [fast]以团队为单位花费1[per_investigator]个线索：将你的地点翻面。(团队每轮每地点限制一次。) 目标 – 如果胜利牌区内有4张未了之事，推进。
back_text:
如果本场景是通过达成目标推进：
“等等，”尚说道，一边稳住自己。他的眼睛翻白，然后倒在你怀里，全身颤抖。你周围的魂体能量似乎静止了。
找出场上每张饥饿的灵魂并放置到胜利牌区。(→R1)
否则：
“太多了！” 尚一边尖叫一边用手摀住流血的耳朵。当你们逃离现场时，一阵刺耳的叫声回响在狂风扫过的山丘上。
每有一个仍在彼端的异端者敌人，吉姆·卡尔弗受到1点精神创伤(最少1点精神创伤)。每位其他未退场的调查员被击败，并受到1点精神创伤。(→R2)
flavor: 如果你帮助这些鬼魂，它们也会帮助你。

flavor: "You call this archaeology?"
back_flavor: Young Jack traveled the world with his father’s archaeological expeditions. Now a globe-trotting treasure hunter and an accomplished archaeologist in his own right, “Monterey” follows in his father’s footsteps, securing the treasures of ancient civilizations and lost cultures. But after discovering a silver pendant with a familiar symbol on it, Monterey must explore his own past. Years ago, his father was found murdered with the very same sigil carved onto his forehead. The image has haunted Monterey’s dreams ever since. But he’s getting close. He won’t stop until he solves the mystery of his father’s murder... no matter what it takes.

real_text: Evade. Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this evasion attempt. If a symbol was revealed during this evasion attempt, return Ethereal Form to your hand at the end of your turn.

flavor: Either the house is alive, or the creature within its walls has grown to encompass it entirely. Your only hope now is to either secure all of the rooms, turn this place into rubble, or flee and make sure nobody ever ventures near this place ever again.
back_flavor:
Wood cracks and splinters as the walls press in around you. Furniture topples, making way for more of the creature's slithering tentacles. They wrap around your limbs and pin you to the floor as the ceiling descends, warped and contorted. It is a pulsating organ, a stomach devouring its meal. Wood, caulk, and plaster enclose you as the house's rumblings dissolve into muffled gnashing.
Your senses are flooded with a surge of adrenaline, and you shake out of the thing's grip. Head pounding, you sprint out of the house as its doors slam open and shut like hungry mouths.

name: 雷克斯·墨菲
text:
[reaction] 当你将要在你所在地点放置1个线索,或者在混乱袋中加入2个[curse]标记时：改为执行另一项。(这仍然能够满足一个能力的费用)
[elder_sign]效果：本次检定抽出的每个[curse]标记+2。本次检定每抽出一个[curse]标记，抽一张牌。
back_text: 卡牌张数：30。 牌组构建选项：探求者([seeker])等级 0-3，[[诅咒萦绕]]和[[局势]] 卡牌等级0-4, 中立卡牌等级 0-5, 最多5张流浪者([rogue])等级0。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：寻找真相，雷克斯的诅咒，1张随机基础弱点。 牌组构建限制：无[[幸运]]或[[祝福]]卡牌(除非它们同时具有[[诅咒萦绕]])。
flavor: "Oh, come on, not <u>again</u>!"
back_flavor: When disaster strikes, Rex Murphy is usually on hand, suffering the consequences. After spending a day with Rex, even the most hardened skeptic will concede that the man is cursed. Anytime he had a lead on a good story, something would go wrong, like that business in Innsmouth with the photographs that blew out to sea. His terrible fortune has more than once exposed him to gruesome beasts and occult conspiracies. To survive, Rex has developed an inquisitive mind, keeping one step ahead of the next disaster.

[reaction] When you would either place 1 of your clues on your location, or add 2 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag: Do the other instead. (This can still satisfy the cost of an ability.)

text: 强制 - 当敌军阶段开始时：每位与准备[[赌场]]敌人位于同一地点的调查员将其警戒等级提升1。 强制 - 在调查员击败一个[[赌场]]敌人后：该调查员的警戒等级提升1。
back_text: 将放在一旁的异空间漫步者生成到轮盘赌桌。将遭遇弃牌堆与放在一旁的无序计划遭遇组洗入遭遇牌堆。 将每位调查员的警戒等级提升1。
flavor: 今晚的赌场一片忙碌，对你跟你的团队来说是最好的掩护。希望你计划许久的行动能成功。
back_flavor: 一道声音从轮盘桌传来，响彻整个大厅：“红色19！”桌子附近的某人兴奋地大喊著。片刻过后，同个声音再次响起：“又是红色19！”你周围传来窃窃私语，这种情况几乎不可能发生。你一瞬间感觉到周围的空气仿佛破裂了，但你摇摇头不予理会。接著，就在大厅中的气氛快要恢复正常时，同样的声音不可置信地大喊：“红色19！这是第三次了！”这次你无法再忽视碎裂的感觉，碎裂声变得更密集，接著四周的一切在一瞬间突然变模糊。当你的视线恢复后，一只超乎想像的恐怖生物出现在赌场中央，居高临下地盯著周遭的人类。你的心情沉到谷底，想起伊萨玛拉说过那个遗物可能带来灾难。如果这还不够糟，你很清楚那个灾难是冲著不被泉源拥有者欢迎的人来的。

back_text:
如果阿巴兰·阿里戈里亚加仍在场……
就在你准备庆祝胜利时，一个声音从你身后传来：“你跑进我的赌场，还想偷走我的东西？”阿巴兰站在门边，全身因愤怒而颤抖著。“你会毁了我的心血！我不会让你得逞的！”他所有文明的伪装都已被撕烂，露出了他危险的本质。
将阿巴兰·阿里戈里亚加(失控的阿巴兰)移动到遗物室。
如果阿巴兰·阿里戈里亚加在胜利牌区……
一个愤怒的声音嘶声到：“我不会让你带走它！”阿巴兰不知为何还能站著，他倚靠在你身后的门廊边。即使他看起来摇摇欲坠，但眼中的恨意却仍在沸腾。在你还来不及阻止他的时候，他的手捶上墙上某种机关，然后倒地不起。大块大块的钢制天花板开始从你头上砸落……
每位调查员必须检定[agility](3)。每位检定失败的调查员受到2点伤害。
flavor: 行动开始。你必须开启金库的门，找出时运泉源的所在位置，通过它的秘法防护，然后设法打开存放它的容器。
real_text: [reaction] After you trigger the [action] ability on a [[Game]] location: Remove 1 clue from The Wellspring of Fortune (2 clues instead if you gained resources from the [[Game]] location's ability). Objective - If an investigator controls The Wellspring of Fortune, advance.

name: 出口
text: 每个[[赌场]]敌人失去冷漠和巡逻。 每个[[赌场]]敌人获得猎手和"猎物 - 控制时运泉源的调查员。" 目标 - 如果控制时运泉源的调查员撤退，推进。(小心，任何尚未撤退的调查员都会被留下！)
back_text: 每位未撤退的调查员被击败，并受到1点肉体创伤。(→结局1)
flavor: 进来是一回事；出去又是另一回事了。你现在必须带著你的战利品逃离，感觉像是整座赌场都挡在你与自由之间。
back_flavor: 你曾一瞬间觉得自己不可能完好如初地逃出赌场，保有肉体跟灵魂的完整，但你做到了。感觉像是一场梦，但你还能清楚听见赌场中的骚动声。是时候离开，并消失的无影无踪了。
real_text: Each [[Casino]] enemy loses aloof and patrol. Each [[Casino]] enemy gains hunter and "Prey - Investigator that controls The Wellspring of Fortune." Objective - If the investigator with The Wellspring of Fortune has resigned, advance. (Beware - any investigator who has not resigned will be left behind!)

name: 赌场大厅
text: [action]：撤退。是时候离开这里了！ [action]：从你手牌或你的游戏区域将一张支援面朝下放到赌场大厅的下方，作为你团伙"为了劫案而藏匿"的一部分。(每回合限制一次。)
flavor: 站在赌场大厅中央令人眼花撩乱，到处都是富丽堂皇的装饰跟大呼小叫的热情赌客。
real_text: [action]: Resign. It's time to get out of here! [action]: Place an asset from your hand or play area facedown beneath Casino Floor, as part of your crew's "stash for the heist." (Limit once per turn.)

name: 赌场大厅
text: [action]：撤退。是时候离开这里了！ [action]如果调查员"扮演高额赌客"且你的警戒等级为6或更低，花费2资源：你准备好了送达金库的包裹。查找遭遇牌堆和弃牌堆，找出一张[[赌场]]敌人，将其生成在此，然后将放在一旁的包裹送达剧情卡牌叠加到其上。(团队每场游戏限制一次。)
real_text: [action]: Resign. It's time to get out of here! [action] If an investigator "impersonated a high roller" and your alarm level is 6 or lower, spend 2 resources: You set up a delivery to the vault. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Casino]] enemy, spawn it here, and attach the set-aside Package Delivery story card to it. (Group limit once per game.)

name: 扑克赌桌
traits: 开放区域. 赌场. 游戏
text: [action]花费2资源：弃掉遭遇牌堆顶的5张卡牌，并检查它们的游戏图标。你可以进行一次重调。如果5张卡牌的大小形成顺子，或是至少有3张的卡牌是相同的大小，获得5资源。
flavor: 奥玛哈扑克，没什么好顾虑的，赌注比天高。
back_flavor: 扑克一直都是热门的游戏，每张桌子都坐满来自世界各地的赌客。筹码相互碰撞的声音，无论是出于快乐或不情愿，每一声都代表著对抗命运的赌注。空气中烟雾萦绕，充满了紧张的汗味，还有虚张声势的紧绷。
real_text: [action] Spend 2 resources: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. You may mulligan once. If all 5 cards have a sequential rank, or if 3 or more of the cards have the same rank, gain 5 resources.

name: 轮盘赌桌
traits: 开放区域. 赌场. 游戏
text: [action]花费1资源：声明一个颜色和一个大小。然后，弃掉遭遇牌堆顶的卡牌，并检查它的游戏图标。如果其颜色与大小都和你的声明相符，获得5资源。
flavor: 红还是黑，哪个才是你的幸运色？
back_flavor: 轮盘游戏是在赌客间最热门的游戏，似乎也是经营者的偏好。毕竟蒙特卡罗的这家赌场就是以此命名的。
real_text: [action] Spend 1 resource: Name a color and a rank. Then, discard the top card of the encounter deck and check its game icon. If it matches the named color and rank, gain 5 resources.

name: 百家乐
traits: 开放区域. 赌场. 游戏
text: [action]花费2资源：声明"玩家"、"庄家"或"平局"。弃掉遭遇牌堆顶的2张卡牌，并检查它们的游戏图标。如果其大小的总和大于18，"玩家"获胜。如果其大小的总和小于18，"庄家"获胜。如果其大小的总和等于18，则为"平局"。如果结果与你的声明相符，获得4资源。
back_flavor: 百家乐近百年，甚至更长的时间中，都在法国的贵族与上流社会十分流行。即使在这座赌场中也是如此，衣著华丽、出手阔绰的客人们聚集在百家乐桌边。
real_text: [action] Spend 2 resources: Name "player," "banker," or "tie." Discard the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. If the combined value of their ranks is higher than 18, the "player" wins. If the combined value is lower than 18, the "banker" wins. If the combined value is equal to 18, it is a "tie." If this result matches the result you named, gain 4 resources.

name: 拉霸机
traits: 开放区域. 赌场. 游戏
text: [action]花费1资源：弃掉遭遇牌堆顶的3张卡牌，并检查它们的游戏图标。如果3张卡牌的花色全部相同，或是大小全部相同，获得3资源。
flavor: "中奖了！"
back_flavor: 墙边放著一排机器，等著贪婪的灵魂上钩，引诱他们沉浸在无尽的投币与拉杆中。不需要任何技巧或知识，只要放手臣服于命运的操弄。
real_text: [action] Spend 1 resource: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. If all 3 cards have the same suit or same rank, gain 3 resources.

name: 高注赌桌
traits: 开放区域. 赌场. 游戏
text: [action]如果此处没有线索，花费4资源：请记住你"扮演高额赌客"。弃掉遭遇牌堆顶的5张卡牌，并检查它们的游戏图标。你可以进行一次重调。如果5张卡牌的大小形成顺子，或是花色全部相同，或是其中4张卡牌是相同的大小，获得8资源。
real_text: [action] If there are no clues here, spend 4 resources: Remember that you "impersonated a high roller." Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. You may mulligan once. If all 5 cards have the same suit or a sequential rank, or if 4 of the cards have the same rank, gain 8 resources.

name: 高注赌桌
traits: 开放区域. 赌场. 游戏
text: [action]花费4资源：弃掉遭遇牌堆顶的5张卡牌，并检查它们的游戏图标。你可以进行一次重调。如果5张卡牌的大小形成顺子，或是花色全部相同，或是其中4张卡牌是相同的大小，获得8资源并且请记住你"赢得邪教的护身符"。
real_text: [action] Spend 4 resources: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. You may mulligan once. If all 5 cards have the same suit or a sequential rank, or if 4 cards have the same rank, gain 8 resources and remember that you "won a cultist medallion."

name: 赌场交谊厅
text: [action]如果赌场交谊厅上没有线索：检定[agility](3)。如果你检定成功，请记住你"找到通风口"。
flavor: 这个奢华的区域提供美味的佳肴，宽敞的舞台能容纳各种余兴节目，无数的桌椅提供讨论生意的空间——无论合不合法。
real_text: [action] If there are no clues on Casino Lounge: Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, remember that you "found a vent."

name: 赌场交谊厅
text: [action]如果你"找到通风口"，在赌场交谊厅的调查员作为团队，共同花费2[per_investigator]个线索：移动。移动到守卫室。然后，如果员工通道还未被揭示，揭示员工通道。请记住"通风口开启"。(团队每场游戏限制一次。) 只要"通风口开启"，调查员可以从赌场交谊厅移动到守卫室，就如同它们是连接的地点，反之亦然。
real_text: [action] If you "found a vent," investigators at Casino Lounge spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Move. Move to Guard Room. Then, reveal Staff Access Hallway if it has not already been revealed. Remember that "the vent is open." (Group limit once per game.) While "the vent is open," investigators may move from Casino Lounge to Guard Room as if they were connected, and vice versa.

name: 员工通道
text: 强制 - 在员工通道被翻开时：将阿巴兰·阿里戈里亚加(失控的阿巴兰)生成到老板办公室。将遭遇弃牌堆和放在一旁的时运之选遭遇组一同洗入遭遇牌堆。
back_text: 作为进入员工通道的额外费用，在连接地点的调查员必须作为团队共同花费4[per_investigator]个线索。
flavor: "厕所是往这边走吗？"
back_flavor: 通往管制区域的门透著亮光……你必须找个办法在没人看守入口时偷偷溜进去。
real_text: Forced - When Staff Access Hallway is revealed: Spawn Abarran Arrigorriagakoa (Abarran Unleashed) at Owner's Office. Shuffle the encounter discard pile and the set-aside Fortune's Chosen encounter set into the encounter deck.

name: 监控室
text: [action]：选择1、2或3张。从遭遇牌堆顶弃掉该数量的卡牌，并检查它们的游戏图标。如果有图示与在场上敌人上的大小相符，请记住你"监视员工们"。如果其大小的总和大于等于19，抽取遭遇弃牌堆顶的卡牌。
back_flavor: 门上的牌子写著"监控室"。你听说他们有某种办法监视整个赌场，也许门后会有答案？
real_text: [action]: Choose 1, 2, or 3. Discard that many cards from the top of the encounter deck and check their game icons. If an icon matches the rank of an enemy in play, remember that you "observed the staff." If the combined value of the discarded cards is 19 or higher, draw the top card in the encounter discard pile.

name: 守卫室
text:
[action]如果以下的所有情况都成立，请记住你"伪装成守卫"：
- 守卫室没有敌人。
- 守卫室上没有剩余的线索。
- 有调查员"取得员工制服"。
back_flavor: 透过门缝，你看见一个满是保全制服与装备的房间。
real_text:
[action] If all of the following are true, remember that you "impersonated a guard:"
- There are no enemies at Guard Room.
- There are no clues remaining on Guard Room.
- An investigator "obtained an employee uniform."

name: 老板办公室
text:
X等同于位于老板办公室的调查员中最高的警戒等级。
[action]如果老板办公室上没有剩余的线索：请记住你"找到阿巴兰的符咒"。
back_text: 老板办公室被上锁了。作为进入老板办公室的额外费用，在连接地点的调查员必须作为团队共同花费2[per_investigator]个线索。除非有调查员"盗取阿巴兰的钥匙"。
flavor: 阿巴兰办公室中的抽屉跟保险箱都上了锁。办公室另一端的墙上有个透过假墙窥视赌场大厅的孔洞。
back_flavor: 门上的名牌写著"阿巴兰·阿里戈里亚加"。里面一定藏著重要的秘密或宝物，如果你能设法进去的话……
real_text:
X is equal to the highest alarm level among investigators at Owner's Office.
[action] If there are no clues on Owner's Office: Remember that you "found Abarran's sigil."

name: 会计室
text:
[action]在会计室的调查员作为团队共同花费10[per_investigator]资源(如果你"找到通风口"，改为花费5[per_investigator]资源)：请记住你"取得蓝图"。
[reaction]在你成功调查会计室并超过难度2点或更多后：获得2资源。(每回合限制一次。)
back_flavor: 筹码跟钱币的碰撞声从门内传来，你不是为了钱而来的，对吧……？
real_text:
[action] Investigators at Counting Room spend 10 [per_investigator] resources, as a group (5 [per_investigator] instead if you "found a vent"): Remember that you "obtained a schematic."
[reaction] After you successfully investigate Counting Room by 2 or more: Gain 2 resources. (Limit once per turn.)

name: 金库大门
text: [action] 移动。弃掉遭遇牌堆顶的卡牌，并检查它的游戏图标。(如果有调查员"取得蓝图"，你可以重调最多两次)： - 如果其花色为♣或♠：移动到守卫室。 - 如果其花色为♥：移动到赌场交谊厅。 - 如果其花色为♦：移动到百家乐。
back_text: 赌场的金库大门锁上了、被严密看守著，且还有魔法的保护。你不能进入金库大门，除非你已经完成在劫案开始剧情卡牌上的至少4项任务。
back_flavor: 巨大的钢门挡在你面前，细致的沟纹由上至下隽刻在金库门上，似乎是用来导引保持大门封闭的秘术能量。
real_text: [action] Move. Discard the top card of the encounter deck and check its game icon (if an investigator "obtained a schematic," you may mulligan up to two times): - Ifits suit is ♣ or ♠: Move to Guard Room. - If its suit is ♥: Move to Casino Lounge. - If its suit is ♦: Move to Baccarat Table.

name: 遗物室
text: 强制 - 在遗物室被翻开后：将时运泉源上的所有线索移动到遗物室。 [action]如果遗物室上没有剩余的线索：控制时运泉源，将其叠加到你的调查员卡牌。
back_text:
你不能进入遗物室。
金库大门获得："[action]除非有调查员"找到阿巴兰的符咒"，否则受到1点伤害和1点恐惧：检定[willpower]或[agility](4)。如果你检定成功，在金库大门的调查员可以作为团队共同花费4[per_investigator]个线索，来翻开遗物室。
flavor: 钱币外型的遗物以令人不安的速度，伴随著能量脉动著。希望你能找到办法破解它的秘密。
real_text: Forced - After Relic Room is revealed: Move all clues from The Wellspring of Fortune to Relic Room. [action] If there are no clues on Relic Room: Take control of The Wellspring of Fortune and attach it to your investigator card.

name: 事前准备
text:
以下是你可以在时运与愚行，第一部分中完成的任务： □调查员"找到通风口"。 □调查员"扮演高额赌客"。 □调查员"说服伊萨玛拉参与劫案"。 □调查员"取得员工制服"。 □调查员"盗取阿巴兰的钥匙"。 □调查员"满载而归"。
强制 - 在一位调查员退场(被击败或是撤退)时：将该调查员的所有线索放到本剧情卡牌上，而不是将它们放到其所在地点上。
back_text: 以下是你可以在时运与愚行，第二部分中完成的任务： □调查员"赢得邪教的护身符"。 □调查员"监视员工们"。 □调查员"找到阿巴兰的符咒"。 □调查员"取得蓝图"。 □调查员"伪装成守卫"。 □调查员"成功隐匿"。 □调查员"运送诱饵包裹"。 □ "伊萨玛拉用歌声迷惑守卫"。 提示：你必须至少完成4项任务才能打开金库大门。
real_text:
Each of the following is a task that can be completed in Fortune and Folly, Part I: □ An investigator "found a vent." □ An investigator "impersonated a high roller." □ An investigator "convinced Isamara to participate in the heist." □ An investigator "obtained an employee uniform." □ An investigator "stole Abarran's keys." □ An investigator "cleaned out the house."
Forced - When an investigator is eliminated (by defeat or resignation): Place each of that investigator's clues on this story card, instead of placing them at their location.

name: 制服合身的话……
text:
这名员工的制服大小看起来很适合你。
[action]：攻击。这次攻击只能对被叠加的敌人执行。检定[combat](3)。如果你检定成功，被叠加的敌人被击倒(阅读以下部分)。如果你检定失败，将你的警戒等级提升1。 如果被叠加的敌人离场，从游戏中移除本剧情卡牌。
如果被叠加的敌人被击倒： 请记住你"取得员工制服"。 如果有另一个敌人在你的所在地点或是一个连接地点上，将你的警戒等级提升1。 丢弃被叠加的敌人。从游戏中移除本剧情卡牌。
back_text:
你将包裹交给员工。
被叠加敌人的巡逻地点改为金库大门。被叠加的敌人失去其[[赌场]]属性。 如果被叠加的敌人进入金库大门，则包裹已送达(阅读以下部分)。 如果被叠加的敌人离场，从游戏中移除本剧情卡牌。
如果被包裹已送达： 选择一位调查员，其查找自己的牌堆，找出一张[[盟友]]或[[道具]]支援，并将其面朝下放到金库大门下方。请记住你"运送诱饵包裹"。 丢弃被叠加的敌人，并将本剧情卡牌叠加到金库大门。 [action]：将面朝下放在金库大门下方的支援放置入场，在你的控制之下。从游戏中移除本剧情卡牌。
real_text:
This casino employee looks like they are wearing a uniform in your size.
[action]: Fight. Perform this attack only on the attached enemy. Test [combat] (3). If you succeed, attached enemy has been knocked out (read the section below). If you fail, raise your alarm level by 1. If attached enemy leaves play, remove this story card from the game.
If attached enemy is knocked out: Remember that you "obtained an employee uniform." Raise your alarm level by 1 if another enemy is at your location or a connecting location. Discard the attached enemy. Remove this story card from the game.

name: 时运不济
text:
伊萨玛拉警告过你，你在追寻的遗物有呼唤不幸的力量，尤其是降临在不合其拥有者心意的人身上。也许你应该将突发状况考虑进计划内，在劫案进行途中，所有事情都可能发生……
将本卡牌翻到背面，并结算另一面上的文字。
back_text:
就在要开始行动时，灯光闪烁几下后完全熄灭，赌场陷入一片黑暗，周边响起了恐慌的惊呼。这厄运的背后感觉像是某种力量在作祟。你现在必须摸黑行事了，除非你能找到办法恢复电力。
将本卡牌放置入场，放到密谋牌堆旁。在每个地点上分别放置一个伤害标记。 每个有伤害标记的地点没有照明并获得："本地点得到+1隐藏值。作为你触发本地点上能力的额外费用，你必须花费额外一次行动或受到1点恐惧。" 有调查员在监控室时，他可以执行以下行动： [action]：花费1[per_investigator]个线索。选择一项 - - 将公共区域的电力恢复正常。从每个[[开放区域]]地点移除一个伤害标记。 - 将员工区域的电力恢复正常。从每个[[管制区域]]地点移除一个伤害标记。

text:

back_text:
发生在赌场内的意外只能用极度不寻常，甚至诡异来形容。玻璃破碎、赌客因踩到骰子而跌倒，还有人被吊灯砸到头。
将本卡牌放置入场，放到密谋牌堆旁。依次执行，每位调查员弃掉遭遇牌堆顶的卡牌，并检查它的游戏图标。游戏剩余期间，以下的受伤类型将影响该调查员： - 如果其花色为♥：你每回合只能执行一次移动行动。 - 如果其花色为♦：你每回合只能执行一次调查行动。 - 如果其花色为♣：你每回合只能执行一次攻击行动。 - 如果其花色为♠：你每回合只能执行一次启动行动。 [free]受到1点伤害或1点恐惧：忽略你受伤的效果，直到你的回合结束。任何调查员可以触发此能力。(每回合限制一次。)

name: 进入虚空
text: 强制 - 在一个[[科学家]]支援将被击败时：改为被绑架(放在一旁，位于场外)。
back_text:
如果场上有时空异常剧情卡牌： 在一个(没有异常的?)河滨码头地点放置1[per_investigator]点恐惧，作为异常。然后，在每个有异常的地点上各加上1个异常。
如果场上有黑帮纠缠剧情卡牌： 将其翻面。将3张放在一旁的谢尔顿帮派成员敌人洗入遭遇牌库。如果场上有[[现在]]的滴答俱乐部，将放在一旁的老萨迪·谢尔顿敌人生成于此。
如果场上有不可名状的异形剧情卡牌： 将其翻面。将放在一旁的提尔斯哈敌人生成在廷达洛斯。
如果场上有恶毒对弈剧情卡牌： 将其翻面。如果你处于过去时代，将放在一旁的艾德温·贝内特敌人生成在调查员队长所在地点。
flavor: 为了修复时间线，你必须穿过曲径迷宫，解救被困在廷达洛斯的受害者，然后重现托马斯和玛丽人生历程中的重大事件。
back_flavor: 时空旅行可能会导致意料之外的后果……
real_text: Forced - When a [[Scientist]] asset would be defeated: It is abducted instead (set it aside, out of play).

name: 时光荏苒
text: 强制 - 在一个[[科学家]]支援将被击败时：改为被绑架(放在一旁，位于场外)。
back_text: 每位在任意时代剩下的调查员被击败并受到1点精神创伤。 如果艾德温·贝内特支援在任意时代的场上，进入(→结局2)。 如果艾德温·贝内特敌人在任意时代的场上，进入(→结局3)。 否则，进入(→结局4)。
flavor: 你越深入廷达洛斯，就越容易吸引其中的爪牙们注意并追捕你。如果你不抓紧时间完成任务，你可能就要永远滞留在廷达洛斯了。
back_flavor: 就算你用尽浑身解数、逃遍天涯海角，成群的猎犬还是会对你纠缠不断、紧追不舍。牠们从角度空间中出现，把你抓住并拖进牠们的领域，承受地狱般的折磨。你再也进行不下去了。你修复时间线的努力失败了。
real_text: Forced - When a [[Scientist]] asset would be defeated: It is abducted instead (set it aside, out of play).

name: 时间穿越
text: [[科学家]]支援上的能力可以被该支援所在地点的任意调查员触发。 [reaction]在你移动到一个地点时，如果你所在地点至少有1个[[科学家]]支援：将其中任意数量的支援和你一起移动至该地点。 目标 - 为了修复时间线，完成所有剧情卡牌上的目标。如果所有3个时代中，托马斯·科里根和玛丽·杰林斯基都位于非廷达洛斯地点，且每个时代中都没有剧情卡牌在场上，推进。
flavor: 你紧张地穿过前往廷达洛斯的次元门，踏入一个超脱时间的深层未知领域。
back_flavor:
你看著托马斯和玛丽荣获他们应得的诺贝尔奖，长舒了一口气。时间线看来已经被修补完整，一切都已恢复原样。你收到了由衷的感谢。他们会为人类留下伟大的遗产，而你为这份遗产做出了至关重要的贡献。
你谨慎地希望艾德温的阴谋已经被完全瓦解了。廷达洛斯的势力可能永远不会收起獠牙。你只能继续保持警惕。但愿你对时间的干预不会造成新的悖论。
real_text: Abilities on [[Scientist]] assets can be triggered by any investigator at that asset's location. [reaction] When you move to a location, if one or more [[Scientist]] assets are at your location: Move any number of them with you. Objective - Restore the timeline by completing the objective on each story card. If Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski are at non-Tindalos locations in all 3 eras, and each era has no story cards in play, advance.

flavor:
托马斯与玛丽相遇时，双方都是就读于米斯卡塔尼克大举的优等生。让这两位聪明的学者相见并发展出永恒的友谊至关重要。
知名发明家尼古拉·特斯拉正在周游美国，最近坐船来到了阿卡姆。你知道托马斯和玛丽参观过特斯拉的发明展示，这场电闪雷鸣般的经历极大地激励了他们对科学的追求。
米斯卡塔尼克大学为了推动科学发展，正计划升级或扩建校园。其中建造一座天文台的呼声最高，但在资金紧缺的情况下，如此昂贵的设施几乎无法建成。一笔可观的捐款肯定能帮助这样的重要项目逐渐走上正轨。

托马斯和玛丽相信他们就快破解如何让人类在时空中穿梭了。
如此重大的发现本应已经发生——托马斯和玛丽赢得诺贝尔奖，他们在世界各地享受赞誉，他们在<u>阿卡姆报社</u>庆祝自己的成功——然而，现在却找不到任何相关的迹象。除非你亲自介入……

[reaction]在你发动技能检定时，消耗托马斯·科里根：如果你检定成功，抽取1张卡牌。
real_text:
Each investigator at Thomas Corrigan's location gets +1 [willpower].
[reaction] When you initiate a skill test, exhaust Thomas Corrigan: If you succeed, draw 1 card.

name: 玛丽·杰林斯基
subname: 科里根工业联合创办人
traits: 科学家. 盟友. 未来
text: 玛丽·杰林斯基所在地点的每位调查员得到+1[intellect]。 [action]消耗玛丽·杰林斯基：调查。如果你检定成功，不发现你所在地点的1个线索，改为获得1个线索(从供应堆拿取)。
real_text: Each investigator at Mary Zielinski's location gets +1 [intellect]. [action] Exhaust Mary Zielinski: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering a clue at your location, gain 1 clue (from the token pool).

name: 恶毒对弈
text:
冒险设置：遵循以下与你所对应的(一个或多个)时代的指示。
过去：将托马斯·科里根放在一旁，位于场外；他被绑架了。将玛丽·杰林斯基放在阿卡姆公报。将艾德温·贝内特敌人放在一旁，位于场外。
现在和未来：将托马斯·科里根和玛丽·杰林斯基放在一旁，位于场外；他们被绑架了。如果你以多组史诗模式进行游戏，将艾德温·贝内特敌人放在一旁，位于场外。
back_text: [action][action]：准备艾德温·贝内特并将其移动到你所在地点(即使他在另一个时代)。 [action]如果艾德温·贝内特位于你所在地点：攻击/躲避。攻击或尝试躲避艾德温·贝内特。如果你检定成功，以团队为单位花费X个线索，其中X为所有玩家总数。然后，将1资源放到他身上，作为1猎杀。(团队每轮限制一次。) 目标 - 如果艾德温·贝内特上有3猎杀，且他位于廷达洛斯，廷达洛斯的势力对他进行追捕。将艾德温·贝内特从游戏中移除，并将所有时代中的本剧情卡牌都加入胜利牌区。
flavor: 这里完全没有艾德温·贝内特的一点线索，但你知道他随时可能会出现在任何地点。他现已精神错乱、执迷不悟，发誓要向"背叛他"的人复仇。名望和荣誉都将只属于他自己。没有任何事物能改变他的想法。
real_text:
Setup: Follow the instructions for your relevant era(s), below.
Past: Set Thoman Corrigan aside, out of play; he has been abducted. Place Mary Zielinski at Arkham Gazette. Set the Edwin Bennet enemy aside, out of play.
Present and Future: Set Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski aside, out of play; they have been abducted. If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, set the Edwin Bennet enemy aside, out of play.

name: 救赎前同事
text:
冒险设置：遵循以下与你所对应的(一个或多个)时代的指示。然后，将此剧情卡牌翻面。
过去：将玛丽·杰林斯基放在一旁，位于场外；她被绑架了。将托马斯·科里根放在童年之家。如果你以多组史诗模式进行游戏，将艾德温·贝内特敌人放在一旁，位于场外。
现在：将托马斯·科里根和玛丽·杰林斯基放在一旁，位于场外；他们被绑架了。将艾德温·贝内特敌人生成在[[现在]]的米斯卡塔尼克大学。
未来：将托马斯·科里根和玛丽·杰林斯基放在一旁，位于场外；他们被绑架了。如果你以多组史诗模式进行游戏，将艾德温·贝内特敌人放在一旁，位于场外。
back_text: [action][action]：准备艾德温·贝内特并将其移动到你所在地点(即使他在另一个时代)。 [action]如果艾德温·贝内特位于你所在地点：谈判。检定[willpower](3)或[intellect](3)。如果你检定成功，以团队为单位花费X个线索，其中X为所有玩家总数。然后，将1资源放到他身上，作为1救赎。 目标 -如果艾德温·贝内特上有至少3点救赎，且他和托马斯·科里根、玛丽·杰林斯基位于任意的米斯卡塔尼克大学，他得到了救赎。移除其上的所有救赎并将其翻面。将所有时代中的本剧情卡牌都加入胜利区。
flavor: 艾德温·贝内特对前同事的怨恨已几近失控，必须迅速制服他。你心无旁鹜，决心恢复他的理智并化解仇杀之恨。
real_text:
Setup: Follow the instructions for your relevant era(s), below. Then, flip this story card over.
Past: Set Mary Zielinski aside, out of play; she has been abducted. Place Thomas Corrigan at Childhood Home. If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, set the Edwin Bennet enemy aside, out of play.
Present: Set Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinsky aside, out of play: they have been abducted. Spawn the Edwin Bennet enemy at Miskatonic University.
Future: Set Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski aside, out of play; they have been abducted. If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, set the Edwin Bennet enemy aside, out of play.

name: 不安同盟
text:
冒险设置：遵循以下与你所对应的(一个或多个)时代的指示。然后，将此剧情卡牌翻面。
过去：将托马斯·科里根放在童年之家。将玛丽·杰林斯基放在奥马利钟表店。将艾德温·贝内特支援放在阿卡姆公报在其上放置12个线索，然后移除其上的3[per_investigator]个线索。
现在和未来：将托马斯·科里根和玛丽·杰林斯基放在一旁，位于场外；他们被绑架了。如果你以多组史诗模式进行游戏，将艾德温·贝内特支援放在一旁，位于场外。
back_text: [action]如果艾德温·贝内特位于你所在地点且处于准备状态：谈判。将你的1个线索放在他身上。你可以检定[intellect](4)。如果你检定成功，再将你的1个线索放在他身上。如果你检定失败，将他消耗。 [action]：准备并将艾德温·贝内特移动到你所在地点(即使他在另一个时代)。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：移除艾德温·贝内特上的1个线索(如果你以多组史诗模式进行游戏，改为移除2个线索)。如果你不能这么做，在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果能导致当前密谋推进。 强制 - 在艾德温·贝内特将要被绑架时：改为移除其所有伤害和恐惧，并在当前密谋上放置2个毁灭标记。 目标 -如果"托马斯和玛丽荣获诺贝尔奖"，且场上任意时代都没有[[情节]]剧情卡牌，将本剧情卡牌加入胜利牌区。
flavor: 过去的一切似乎都没有异常。你不确定艾德温·贝内特是否值得信任。他渊博的知识确实能替你带来极大的帮助。你极不情愿地说服自己回报值得冒险，但你需要费尽心思说服艾德温，防止他背叛你。
real_text:
Setup: Follow the instructions for your relevant era(s), below. Then, flip this story card over.
Past: Place Thomas Corrigan at Childhood Home. Place Mary Zielinski at O'Malley's Watch Shop. Place the Edwin Bennet asset at Arkham Gazette with 12 clues on him, then remove 3 [per_investigator] clues from him.
Present and Future: Set Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinsky aside, out of play: they have been abducted. If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, set the Edwin Bennet asset aside, out of play.

name: 艾德温·贝内特
text: 巡逻(最近有[[科学家]]支援的地点)。 艾德温·贝内特不会受到伤害。 不能发现艾德温·贝内特所在地点的线索。 强制 - 当神秘阶段结束时：对艾德温·贝内特所在地点的1个[[科学家]]支援造成1点伤害。
real_text: Patrol (nearest location with a [[Scientist]] asset). Edwin Bennet cannot be damaged. Clues cannot be discovered from Edwin Bennet's location. Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Deal 1 damage to a [[Scientist]] asset at Edwin Bennet's location.

name: 艾德温·贝内特
text: [fast]如果现在是你的回合且你位于[[次元门]]地点，消耗艾德温·贝内特并花费2资源：移动到廷达洛斯。
flavor: 有著真才实学，却也反复无常的谋略者。
real_text: [fast] If it is your turn and you are at a [[Portal]] location, exhaust Edwin Bennet and spend 2 resources: Move to Tindalos.

name: 艾德温·贝内特
text: 巡逻(最近有[[科学家]]支援的地点)。 艾德温·贝内特不会受到伤害。 不能发现艾德温·贝内特所在地点的线索。 强制 - 当神秘阶段结束时：对艾德温·贝内特所在地点每个[[科学家]]支援造成1点伤害。然后，选择一位调查员抽取遭遇牌堆顶的卡牌。
real_text: Patrol (nearest location with a [[Scientist]] asset). Edwin Bennet cannot be damaged. Clues cannot be discovered from Edwin Bennet's location. Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Deal 1 damage to each [[Scientist]] asset at Edwin Bennet's location. Then, choose an investigator to draw the top card of the encounter deck.

name: 艾德温·贝内特
text: 强制 - 在艾德温·贝内特消耗后：选择一位调查员抽取遭遇牌堆顶的卡牌。 [reaction]在你抽取1张遭遇卡牌时，消耗艾德温·贝内特：取消该卡牌的所有效果并将其丢弃。
real_text: Forced - After Edwin Bennet exhausts: Choose an investigator to draw the top card of the encounter deck. [reaction] When you draw an encounter card, exhaust Edwin Bennet: Cancel all of that card's effects and discard it.

name: 时空异常
text: 冒险设置：将1[per_investigator]点恐惧放到每个米斯卡塔尼克大学地点上，作为异常。如果你以多组史诗模式进行游戏，将1[per_investigator]点恐惧放到以下地点，作为异常：阿卡姆公报、阿卡姆报社、奥马利钟表店和滴答俱乐部。 将以下敌人从游戏中移除：提尔斯哈、老萨迪·谢尔顿和所有3张谢尔顿帮派成员。将此剧情卡牌翻面。
back_text: 不能触发有异常的地点的能力。 [action]花费任意数量的线索：检定[willpower](3)或[agility](3)。每以此方式花费1个线索，这次检定你得到+3技能值。如果你检定成功，移除你所在地点的1异常(如果你成功且超过难度至少3点，改为移除2异常)。然后，如果你成功且超过难度至少4点，且"科里根工业成立"，移除任意时代和你所在地点名称相同的地点上的1异常。 目标 -如果当前密谋为2a，且所有地点上都没有异常，将本剧情卡牌加入胜利牌区。
flavor: 表面上似乎是随机的奇怪现象正在影响时空。阿卡姆四处的怪异地点打乱了人们的日常生活，在居民之间散布了恐慌。显然这一切始于米斯卡塔尼克大学，有些人指责是科学大楼内进行的禁忌实验所致。
real_text: Setup: Place 1 [per_investigator] horror on each Miskatonic University location, as anomalies. If you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode, also place 1 [per_investigator] horror on the following locations, as anomalies: Arkham Gazette, Arkham Advertiser, O'Malley's Watch Shop, and Tick-Tock Club. Remove the following enemies from the game: Tyr'thrha, Old Sadie Sheldon, and all 3 copies of Sheldon Gang. Flip this story card over.

name: 黑帮纠缠
text: 冒险设置：将老萨迪·谢尔顿敌人和所有3张谢尔顿帮派成员敌人放在一旁，位于场外。将提尔斯哈敌人从游戏中移除。你和老萨迪·谢尔顿顿做了笔交易：每位在现在时代的调查员获得2资源。
back_text: [action]如果"债务已偿还"，以团队为单位花费1[per_investigator]个线索：查找游戏区域、遭遇牌堆或遭遇弃牌堆，找出一个谢尔顿帮派成员敌人并将其加入胜利牌区。如果你查找过遭遇牌堆，将其混洗。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。 目标 - 如果所有3个谢尔顿帮派成员敌人都在胜利牌区，将本剧情卡牌加入胜利牌区。
flavor: 被选上绝路时往往只能铤而走险。你别无他法，只能前去寻求恶名昭著的帮派头目——老萨迪·谢尔顿的协助。谢尔顿以大批量非法贩卖加拿大威士忌闻名，他和手下的帮派持有众多资金储备，以提供给那些急需借贷的人。只不过你要记得及时偿还这位暴脾气黑帮老大的债务……
real_text: Setup: Set the Old Sadie Sheldon enemy and all 3 copies of the Sheldon Gang enemy aside, out of play. Remove the Tyr'thrha enemy from the game. You make a deal with Old Sadie Sheldon: each investigator playing the present era gains 2 resources.

name: 老萨迪·谢尔顿
traits: 类人. 罪犯. 犯罪团伙
text: 冷漠。 每个谢尔顿帮派成员敌人得到+1攻击和+1躲避。 [action]：谈判。检定[intellect](2)。如果你检定成功，以团队为单位花费3[per_investigator]资源，将老萨迪·谢尔顿加入胜利牌区并宣告"债务已偿还。"
real_text: Aloof. Each Sheldon Gang enemy gets +1 fight and +1 evade. [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, spend 3 [per_investigator] resources, as a group, to add Old Sadie Sheldon to the victory display and announce "the debt has been paid."

name: 谢尔顿帮派成员
traits: 类人. 罪犯. 犯罪团伙. 精英
text: 涌动。猎手。庞大。 谢尔顿帮派成员得到+2[per_investigator]生命值。 强制 - 在谢尔顿帮派成员所在地点的调查员打出一张卡牌后：准备谢尔顿帮派成员，并弃掉遭遇牌堆顶的3张卡牌。将每个以此方式丢弃的[[罪犯]]敌人放置入场，位于该地点。
real_text: Surge. Hunter. Massive. Sheldon Gang gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After an investigator at Sheldon Gang's location plays a card: Ready Sheldon Gang and discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Put each [[Criminal]] enemy discarded this way into play at that location.

name: 不可名状的异形
text: 冒险设置：将提尔斯哈敌人放在一旁，位于场外。将老萨迪·谢尔顿敌人和所有3张谢尔顿帮派成员敌人从游戏中移除。
back_text: [action]如果提尔斯哈位于你所在地点，花费1个线索：检定[intellect](3)。如果你检定成功，对提尔斯哈造成2点伤害(如果你成功并超过难度至少3点，改为3点伤害)。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。 目标 - 如果提尔斯哈被击败，将本剧情卡牌加入胜利牌区。
flavor:
廷达洛斯时空的极度扭曲影响了其中的一切。潜伏于角度时间之领域的生物不仅仅有萨蒂尔和廷达洛斯猎犬——有一个较它们指数般巨大、更为强大的存在，甚至能扭曲时空本身。
在这座巨大迷宫中游荡的人，必定会招致居住于此之物的仇视，而廷达洛斯至高领主的怒火是无可比拟的。
real_text: Setup: Set the Tyr'thrha enemy aside, out of play. Remove the Old Sadie Sheldon enemy and all 3 copies of the Sheldon Gang enemy from the game.

name: 提尔斯哈
traits: 古神. 廷达洛斯. 精英
text: 庞大。反击。巡逻(最近有[[科学家]]支援的地点)。 *提尔斯哈的总生命值池为6[per_investigator]。 强制 - 在提尔斯哈进入一个地点时：每个位于该地点的[[科学家]]支援被绑架。
real_text: Massive. Retaliate. Patrol (nearest location with a [[Scientist]] asset). *Tyr'thrha has a global health pool of 6 [per_investigator]. Forced - When Tyr'thrha enters a location: Each [[Scientist]] asset at that location is abducted.

name: 恐怖萨蒂尔
traits: 怪物. 异次元. 廷达洛斯
text: 巡逻(最近有[[科学家]]支援的地点)。 恐怖萨蒂尔位于[[过去]]地点时得到+1攻击，位于[[现在]]地点时得到+2攻击。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时，如果恐怖萨蒂尔准备：对其所在地点的每个[[科学家]]支援造成1点伤害。
real_text: Patrol (nearest location with a [[Scientist]] asset). Ghastly Satyr gets +1 fight while it is at a [[Past]] location and +2 fight while it is at a [[Present]] location. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Ghastly Satyr is ready: Deal 1 damage to each [[Scientist]] asset at its location.

name: 廷达洛斯猎犬
traits: 怪物. 异次元. 廷达洛斯
text: 巡逻(最近有[[科学家]]支援的地点)。 廷达洛斯猎犬位于[[现在]]地点时得到+1生命值，位于[[未来]]地点时得到+2生命值。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时，如果廷达洛斯猎犬准备：对其所在地点的每个[[科学家]]支援造成1点恐惧，并将其所在地点的每个[[科学家]]支援和调查员移动到廷达洛斯。
real_text: Patrol (nearest location with a [[Scientist]] asset). Hound of Tindalos gets +1 health while it is at a [[Present]] location and +2 health while it is at a [[Future]] location. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Hound of Tindalos is ready: Deal 1 horror to each [[Scientist]] asset at its location, and move each [[Scientist]] asset and investigator at its location to Tindalos.

name: 角度众多之物
traits: 怪物. 异次元. 廷达洛斯. 精英
text: 生成 - 廷达洛斯。 猎手。只要角度众多之物位于…… - ……[[过去]]地点，它得到+1躲避并获得警戒。 - ……[[现在]]地点，它得到+1伤害和+1恐惧。 - ……[[未来]]地点，它得到+1攻击并获得反击。
real_text: Spawn - Tindalos. Hunter. While Many-Angled Thing is at a... - ...[[Past]] location, it gets +1 evade and gains alert. - ...[[Present]] location, it gets +1 damage and +1 horror. - ...[[Future]] location, it gets +1 fight and gains retaliate.

name: 廷达洛斯头犬
traits: 怪物. 异次元. 廷达洛斯
text: 警戒。反击。 强制 - 在廷达洛斯头犬攻击你后：将一个你控制的非剧情支援洗入你的牌堆，其上所有的伤害和恐惧移动至你的调查员。丢弃廷达洛斯头犬。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时：丢弃廷达洛斯头犬。
real_text: Alert. Retaliate. Forced - After Tindalos Alpha attacks you: Shuffle a non-story asset you control into your deck, moving all damage and horror from that asset to your investigator. Discard Tindalos Alpha. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Discard Tindalos Alpha.

name: 时间裂缝
text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。你失败且每低于难度1点，必须失去1个行动或受到1点恐惧。
flavor: 我们曾将时间设想成一条直线，在点到点之间流动。实际与设想的相差甚远。
real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either lose 1 action or take 1 horror.

name: 惨遭绑架
text: 祸害。 显现 - 如果你所在地点没有[[盟友]]支援，惨遭绑架获得涌动。否则，检定[willpower](5)。如果你检定失败，消耗你所在地点的所有[[盟友]]支援，并对其中一个支援造成5点恐惧。
flavor: 在猎犬的领域穿行的人会有成为猎物的风险。
real_text: Peril. Revelation - If there are no [[Ally]] assets at your location, Abducted gains surge. Otherwise, test [willpower] (5). If you fail, exhaust all [[Ally]] assets at your location and deal 5 horror to one of them.

name: 破碎空间
text: 显现 - 如果你位于…… - ……[[过去]]地点，失去3资源。 - ……[[现在]]地点，将你的2个线索放到该地点上。 - ……[[未来]]地点，失去一次行动。
real_text: Revelation - If you are at a... - ...[[Past]] location, lose 3 resources. - ...[[Present]] location, place 2 of your clues on it. - ...[[Future]] location, lose 1 action.

name: 次元裂口

flavor: "Oh honey, I'm making this up as I go along."
back_flavor: Jenny Barnes has spent the majority of her young life in pursuit of creature comforts, fine dining, and the latest fashions. That all changed when she received a letter from her sister, Isabelle. In this letter, Isabelle confessed that mysterious forces were aligning against her and that she feared she may fall victim to some paranormal threat. It was the last letter Jenny received from her beloved sister. Jenny has since returned to the States to track down and investigate all occult occurrences she can find. Hardly a wilting flower, she has proven herself a crack shot as well as a fearless and clever investigator of the unknown. Until Isabelle's disappearance is explained, Jenny will never relent in her search.

back_flavor: Mateo Castile's life has not been easy since he became a priest. Recent decades in Mexico have been wracked with instability and conflict. Father Mateo struggled to balance his faith with the pragmatic concerns of preaching when the law told him he must not. But this is not what has assaulted Mateo's faith at its core. The nearby murders and kidnappings were not politically motivated, as he had suspected. A gruesome and horrid cult thrives at the heart of the brewing war. How, Mateo wonders, could a kind and loving God allow what he saw that night to exist?

flavor: You now know why North Point Mine was abandoned. Writhing abominations and frenzied miners prowl the tunnels, hungry for their next meal.
back_flavor:
The tunnel collapses behind the mine cart to expose a cavern filled with glowing violet crystals. The cart crashes into a boulder to send you flying headlong into the dark. As more tremors rock the tunnel, you scramble to keep ahead of the cave-in, terrified of what might happen if you are trapped here. As you sprint past a rotten, slack-jawed corpse, you almost gag from the stench, then trip on a fallen rock and hit your head.
You wake up hours later, head pounding, and wonder in a daze until you catch the scent of fresh air and follow it out of the mine.

back_text:
Shuffle each copy of the set-aside Out of the Walls and Pulled In treacheries into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.

flavor: Your first steps into the old manor come with a fetid odor and an intense feeling of being watched. The air is too still, and for an abandoned house, there is an unsettling lack of dust on the furniture and floors. If nobody has lived here for years, then why does it feel like everything has moved recently?
back_flavor:
At the sound of creaking wood, you spin to face the hall you came from. Everything looks as it was, and yet you cannot shake the feeling that things are subtly different. Letting out a held breath, you resume your investigation, only to find the furniture in your room settling into place, like children playing a game of musical chairs. A slimy tentacle retreats between a gap in the wood.
The rumors regarding Hemlock House were only half right. There is something living within its walls. But it is something far worse than you could have imagined.

back_flavor: The house groans and creaks, as though it is still settling. Movement stirs in the corner of your eye: the floor itself ripples like water as something moves beneath the creaking old boards.

flavor: The legacy of Pearl Ridge is a story of note amongst the locals. The Pearls were a prominent family like the Hemlocks and Atwoods, but the family vanished in a curious incident back in 1906. What could have happened here?
back_flavor: Amongst the ruins of the Pearl Estate, you find Susan Pearl's diary. It details attempts to explore tunnels beneath the ridge. They were called "The Warrens" due to their mazelike structure. Perhaps some of the Pearl family disappeared in the surrounding tunnels, but why? You resolve to investigate.

The bodies are painful to look at, their faces frozen in silent agony. Some invisible, heavy presence fills the air above the corpses, although there is no motion, no breeze or dust. flavor: Waves crash on the shoreline, threatening to wipe out a set of footprints that lead into the tidal caverns. You catch the faintest glimpse of a dim, blue glow deep within the tunnels.
back_flavor: A whirring, chittering sound echoes off the tunnel walls. A large, crab-like creature emerges from a nearby tidal pool, antennae swaying in the air as if searching for you. The thing moves surprisingly fast on dozens of legs, and its carapace is covered in sharp barnacles and strings of kelp and rotten seaweed. Whatever it is, it emits the most awful, rotten stench you have ever smelled.
real_text: Cards at [[Dark]] locations use (Night [night]) effects. Cards at all other locations use (Day [day]) effects.

name: Darkness Closes In
text: Cards at [[Dark]] locations use (Night [night]) effects. Cards at all other locations use (Day [day]) effects.
back_text: Each surviving investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
flavor: The cavern walls are alive with churning, shifting fungal growths. And they seem to be following you.
back_flavor:
You find yourself surrounded in the dark by dozens of shadowy forms, clacking and chittering. More unsettling still is the soft glowing moss that spreads across the slick walls and ceiling of the tidal cave. As the creatures and shifting moss press in, suffocatingly close, you lose your balance and fall into a thick carpet of moss. Up close, you see small buds and spiny growths in the moss that palpitate and turn toward you like a hundred tiny mouths.
As you feel your limbs go numb, a pair of hands pulls you from the moss. Helen Peters drags you bodily out of the cave, cursing under her breath.

name: The Missing Sibling
text: Forced - After the last clue is discovered from a [[Cave]] location: Put the top card of the Caverns deck into play adjacent to that location. Objective - Find Elizabeth Peters! If the investigators "found a torn dog leash" and "found a set of footprints," immediately advance.
back_text:
Choose a [[Coastal]] location (with no investigators, if able). Put the set-aside Fungal Cave location into play adjacent to the chosen location.
Put the top card of the Caverns deck into play, adjacent to the Fungal Cave. Repeat this until the Fungal Cave is connected to four locations, or the Caverns deck is empty.
flavor: Elizabeth Peters has gone missing in these coastal caves, chasing after the family dog. Helen is determined to get her back.
back_flavor:
"She's alive. Though I doubt Bruce is," Helen says, gripping the torn dog leash in one hand. You follow her as she tracks a set of footprints deeper into the darkness. As your eyes readjust to the low light, you notice the footprints glow with the leavings of the bioluminescent fungus covering the cavern floors.
"It's this way. Be ready for anything," Helen says. You steel yourself and keep step beside her. Ahead, an unsettling click and whir tell you that you are far from alone...

text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues and choose an enemy at a connecting [[Dark]] location: Move that enemy to your location. Objective - When an investigator enters Fungal Cave, immediately advance.
back_text: Spawn the set-aside Limulus Hybrid at the Fungal Cave. Remove Helen Peters from the game. If Theo Peters is under the control of any investigator, ([codex] Σ) (page 25).
flavor: Lizzie's glowing footprints lead to an unexplored chamber deep in the caverns. Through your exploration, you now know how to lure the ravenous creatures with glowing moss out of the darkness and into the light.
back_flavor:
"Helen!" Elizabeth's shrill, desperate cry cuts through the silence. A young woman with a round face and torn clothes hobbles out of the darkness to embrace her sister. As the pair embrace, their reunion is cut short by a fearsome screech. A massive crustacean the size of a house advances, pincers raised threateningly. The thing's slick, shining form is illuminated in green and blue by the cavern moss, and it emits a smell like rotten shellfish.
"Can you walk?" Helen asks her sister. Lizzie shakes her head. As the massive creature comes closer, you tell the pair to run. Helen looks torn for a moment, then nods in thanks before carrying her sister away.

A filmy blue fluid leaks from its eyes and carapace, smelling like more awful, rotten shellfish. Covering your nose and mouth, you head back to Akwan.

back_text: All of Hemlock Isle has been transfigured in the great ascendance. Each investigator is devoured by the Colour Out of Space (they are killed).
flavor: Your vision refracts like broken glass.
back_flavor:
The rippling air stops, then churns into myriad faces, shapes, and forms. You struggle to breathe as the air is sucked out of your lungs and drawn into a pillar of light. The brilliance ascends into the night sky like a falling star in reverse, reducing everything around you to dust. Trees wither and desiccate, and fleeing wildlife are turned to bone and ash. Your body sublimates, rising into the blinding brilliance along with everything else on Hemlock Isle.
You have learned your place in infinity.

name: Fate of the Vale (v.I)
text: [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test at a [[Lair]] location during your turn: Reveal cards from the bottom of The Abyss for each point you succeed by. Draw each single-sided enemy card revealed by this effect. Remove each other revealed card from the game. [fast] Spend 1 clue: You get +2 skill value for this skill test. Objective - At the end of the round, if each surviving investigator is at The Abyss, investigators may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.
back_text: The investigators must decide (choose one): - Let Dr. Marquez carry out her plan (→R1) (page 66). - Do it ourselves (→R2) (page 67). (You may only choose this if an investigator controls Prismatic Shard story asset.)
flavor: Dr. Marquez needs your help to save the Vale!
back_flavor: You stand next to Dr. Marquez at the base of a mound of desiccated bodies. Above, the Abyss flickers in the still, cold air. A hazy humanoid shape reaches toward you as the brilliance flares again, blindingly bright. "It's no good. We need to disrupt it. Feed it something it can't 'digest,'" Dr. Marquez says soberly. She hands you her satchel filled with survey notes and samples. "I want you to have this." You ask why. "Someone needs to tell Dr. Armitage the story of this..." her eyes narrow, staring up at the flickering iridescence. "...this colour out of space."

name: Fate of the Vale (v.II)
text: [action] Choose and discard 1 card from your hand: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, draw the [[Resident]] card beneath your location, enemy side faceup. You may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues to put it into play exhausted. Objective - If no [[Resident]] enemies are beneath locations or in play, you may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: You'll have to either talk sense into the frenzied residents... or knock it out of them.
back_flavor: "Get in the truck!" A resident waves a crowd of dazed locals onto the vehicle. The remaining survivors pile into trucks and weather-beaten bikes and drive down the winding southern road. As you pass the dilapidated harbor, a pillar of pure light shoots up from the village center followed by an oily, viscous cloud. The train of survivors have just taken refuge in the southern lighthouse when a shockwave of hot air tears across the island with a hurricane force.

name: Fate of the Vale (v.III)
text: [action] Spend X [per_investigator] clues: Place X resources on your location, as kindling (you may spend 5 resources or discard an [[Item]] asset you control to place 1 additional kindling). [action] If your location has kindling on it equal to or greater than its shroud value, remove all kindling from it: Draw 1 set-aside Fire! treachery. (Group limit once per location.) Objective - When the round ends, if there are 5 copies of Fire! in play, immediately advance.
flavor: Your only hope of stopping this thing is to burn this accursed island. All of it.
back_flavor:
Fireworks shoot up into the sky as Hemlock Vale is consumed in the blaze. The whizzing lights and loud crackles almost distract from the devastating inferno as it devours the landscape. Poms of red, yellow, and blue fireworks launch into the air to explode in the night sky.
You and Dr. Marquez join the few remaining survivors on a trek to the island's southern reach to take refuge in a crumbling lighthouse. As you watch the inferno from a smudged window, a thread of thin, gray light shoots up from the village center, then winks out. A small, phosphorescent light plummets back into the blaze like a fallen star.

name: Fate of the Vale (v.IV)
text: [action] If at least 5 of the following are true (the investigators found gas, the investigators found Theo's truck, the road is clear, the survey notes were recovered, Bertie is fleeing, the samples were found): Resign. You flee the Vale. Objective - Escape with your lives! If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
flavor: You must escape with your lives!
back_flavor:
With Dr. Marquez in tow, you gather the few survivors that remain and pile into Theo's sky blue truck. The locals shout directions as you drive south down a winding road to the southernmost point of the island. Shaking from the adrenaline, your small band of survivors takes refuge in the crumbling lighthouse.
Before you enter, you turn to see a sight you will never forget. A pillar of pure light shoots up from the Vale, drawing the oily viscous cloud in its wake. A shockwave tears across the island, and you fall to your knees, exhausted, as though years of your life were stolen from you in a single moment. You are transfixed by the dazzling light as it launches up through the stratosphere and into space.

The sweetness of the air and the vibrant colors are overwhelming. Your pulse is electric as gooseflesh creeps up your arm and your skin prickles, almost as if under an invisible caress.
