If The Bloodless Man (Silent Lurker) is in play:
You turn around to see the Bloodless Man striding toward you with murderous intent. Before you can react, the imposing figure staggers, then falls face first onto the red carpet.

Moments later, a sharp sound of ripping cloth breaks the silence. Glistening appendages erupt from the Bloodless Man's torn suit and limbs, blossoming into a grotesque amalgam of flesh and writhing tentacles. Your stomach churns as the creature's bone-white mask stares down at you, set in a maw of nightmarish limbs and gnashing fangs.
Flip The Bloodless Man (Silent Lurker) to his (Unleashed) side.
Otherwise:
The clamor around you seems to quiet for a moment.
Each investigator may heal 1 horror from an investigator or [[Guest]] asset at their location.
flavor: Commotion stirs deeper within the manor as various guests ask the attendants to be let out. Other guests shuffle through the manor with dead eyes and blank stares.

flavor: The bog is supposedly the origin of the sample that drew Dr. Marquez to the island in the first place. You have your work cut out for you.

Atop a mound of wildflowers is a silvery alkaloid blossom very much like the sample that drew Dr. Marquez to Hemlock Isle. When you approach, the blossom swells to release a cloud of spores, then closes. The scent of the spores is pleasant, almost like cloves, but grows bitter the longer it lingers. Suddenly the mound of flowers moves. A large reptilian head rises out of the water and looks at you with intelligent eyes before swiftly swimming away.

You corner the reptilian creature in a shining pool, where it sinks into the mud, clearly exhausted. As it starts munching on a tangle of flowers, you take several sketches and notes of the thing's sprouting shell. The alkaloid blossom on its back seems to pulse. Producing a pair of shears, you prepare to take a sample.

"Stop!" Dr. Marquez shouts. "That flower is parasitic. It is now part of the creature's anatomy. There's no telling how deeply it's embedded." She points to the flower's thick translucent stem: vicious white fluid pumps through it like an artery. "If the flower dies, its host dies too."
(→R2) (page 30).
flavor: The large flowering turtle-like creature is on the move. Perhaps you can herd it to safety.

back_text: 牌组卡牌张数：35。 牌组构建选项：求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，最多10张其它的探求者和/或流浪者卡牌([seeker]/[rogue])等级0。 牌组构建需求(不计入牌组卡牌张数)：3张冷酷决断、漂流、1张随机基础弱点。 额外设置:在抽取你的起始手牌后，你可以从你的手牌中将任意数量的卡牌面朝下放置到乔治‧巴纳比底下。
back_flavor: 乔治‧巴纳比在他19岁时进入监狱度过了一个月，在这之后他觉得自己有必要成为一名律师。他在事业上取得了巨大的成功，也因此声名狼藉，在邻近退休时，他计划与妻子玛莉亚一起环游世界。然而，就在他退休的前夕，他的家遭到袭击，玛莉亚被异教徒杀害。现在，乔治凭借著他过去医生的财富和人脉，追踪罪魁祸首来到阿卡姆，发誓要将他们绳之以法，为他们可怕的罪刑伸张正义。

Read only if "the escort failed:" Remove Mi-Go Destroyer, Armored Car, and this card from the game. Each investigator takes 1 damage. Lose 1 countermeasure.
Read only if "the car reached its target:"
It’s chilling what a machine of war can do when it’s fully unleashed, but in this case, you’re relieved at the thundering of its gun and the crunch of its tires on alien ground. With this area secure, the military can focus its efforts on the anomaly itself. Although they don’t thank you for your efforts directly, the detachment of agents following you around tells you they view you as an asset.
Put the set-aside G-Men story asset into play under any investigator’s control. Remove Armored Car from the game. Add Mi-Go Destroyer and this card to the victory display. Deal 5 damage to Subject 8L-08.
flavor: You’ve heard from some of the civilians fleeing to the perimeter of the quarantine zone that the military is sending in armor to secure Blackwater. You’re not sure a bigger gun is the answer, but it might help deter the creatures that have been wreaking havoc across the town. If you can clear the path and prevent it from getting devoured like the rest of the vehicles they’ve sent in, maybe it can make a real difference.

name: Reclaim the Brain
text: Revelation - Spawn the set-aside Mi-Go Scientist enemy at the location farthest from the Fungus Mound. Attach the set-aside Brain Case asset to Mi-Go Scientist. Put this card into play next to the act deck. Forced - If Brain Case is at Research Site and under an investigator’s control: Remember that "the brain was recovered." Flip this card over. Forced - If Brain Case is at Fungus Mound and attached to Mi-Go Scientist: Remember that "the brain was taken." Flip this card over.
back_text:
Read only if "the brain was taken:" Remove Mi-Go Scientist, Brain Case, and this card from the game. The investigators, as a group, return 3 of their clues to the token pool.
Read only if "the brain was recovered:"
The scientists listen to your story and examine the cylinder. To your surprise, you hear a distorted voice from what must be a strange speaker stemming from the jar. The brain vibrates within. "Oh, thank the heavens. I can hear you. Where am I?" it asks. You explain what has transpired, and ask why the creatures were after it. "I know something they needed. Here, I can teach you - do you have a pen?"
Put the set-aside Corrosive Cloud story asset into play under any investigator’s control. Remove Brain Case from the game. Add Mi-Go Scientist and this card to the victory display. Any investigator discovers 1 clue each from up to 2 locations. Gain 1 countermeasure.
flavor: You thought you’d seen everything, but when you spot one of the creatures flying overhead with a human brain in its grasp, you realize you’re sorely mistaken. Even more surprising, it seemed to be cradling the brain safely inside a glass cylinder, as if it were a scientific sample. Are these monsters collecting human brains? The irony isn’t lost on you - the creatures are likely doing the same kind of research as the scientists at the research site - but even still, you have to find this creature and stop this sick experiment!

real_text: Revelation - Put "I'll do it myself" into play in your threat area. As an additional cost for you to play an event, take 1 horror. [fast] Discard 3 events from your hand: Discard "I'll do it myself."

name: 卢修斯‧加洛维
text:
[reaction]在你成功躲避敌人并超过难度至少2点后：发现你所在地点的1个线索。(每轮限制一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：你所在地点每有一名敌人，+1。
back_text: 牌组卡牌张数：30。 牌组构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-5，流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌组构建需求(不计入牌组卡牌张数)：诗文之书、洪灾之梦、1张随机基础弱点。
flavor: "我只是很高兴我所有的梦都留在我的脑海里。"
back_flavor: 卢修斯是在纽约长大的南方移居者，他与哈莱姆区的知识份子、艺术家和音乐家一起创作梦境般的诗歌，并因此声名大噪。与他相同时代的人们不知道的是，卢修斯描述的朦胧水下城市的灵感并非来自纽约，而是来自他失踪的伙伴鲁迪的恶梦。鲁迪失踪前曾经说过，在阿卡姆有一个由入梦者组成的小团体，他们分享者这些令人不安的梦境。现在，卢修斯在米斯卡塔尼克大学担任客座讲师，他在寻找失去的爱人，或许他也在寻找自己恐怖梦境的源头……
real_text:
[reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy by 2 or more: Discover 1 clue at your location. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each enemy at your location.

real_text: Revelation - Put Dreams of the Flood into play in your threat area. Forced - The first time you discover 1 or more clues during your turn: Take 1 horror and shuffle Dreams of the Flood into your deck.

name: 阿加莎‧克雷恩
traits: 米斯卡塔尼克. 学者
text:
[reaction]在你的回合结束时，如果本轮你封印、取消或忽略过至少1个混乱标记：从你的弃牌堆打出一张[[法术]]或[[洞察]]事件卡。在该事件卡结算后，将其从游戏中移除。
[elder_sign]效果：+2。你可以取消此标记并为此抽取另一个标记。如果你这么做，抽取1张卡牌。
back_text: 牌组卡牌张数：35。 牌组构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，[[洞察]]事件卡等级0-3，最多10张其它潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0。 牌组构建需求(不计入牌组卡牌张数)：暗眼之镜、窥视虚空、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 阿加莎‧克雷恩拥有数学和心理学学位，并总是种是以证据为基础的科学。在她年轻的时候，她对那些鬼故事不屑一顾，但越来越多的证据让阿加莎得出结论，阿卡姆历史上流传的怪物和魔法的故事，的确是真实存在的。如果这些东西是真的，那么它们就必须遵守一致的规则。任何人只要听得够久，她将会解释这个新的研究领域叫做"超心理学"，她的丈夫威尔伯也听过很多次了。阿加莎试图用久经验证的科学方法来位神秘和理性、神秘学和科学之间搭建起跨越鸿沟的桥梁。

real_text: Revelation - Put Glimpse the Void into play in your threat area. The first time you reveal 1 or more chaos tokens during each skill test, you must reveal 1 additional chaos token (and resolve its effects). [action]: Shuffle Glimpse the Void into your deck.

name: 迈克尔‧麦克格林
text:
[reaction]在你从一张[[枪械]]支援卡花费至少1子弹后：获得1资源。(每轮每张[[枪械]]支援卡限制一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+2。你可以将1子弹放到你控制的[[枪械]]支援卡上。
back_text: 牌组卡牌张数：30。 牌组构建选项：流浪者卡牌([rogue]) 等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5，属性或文字框中带有[[枪械]]字样的卡牌等级0-5。 牌组构建需求(不计入牌组卡牌张数)："中提琴"盒、充公没收、1张随机基础弱点。
flavor: "管它是不是神。如果它和我作对，就一定会后悔。"
back_flavor: 迈克尔‧麦克格林是一位沉默寡言的人。他无须多说什么；因为他身边有快枪手路易斯。他们两位是欧巴尼恩最强的战士，确保帮派在整个阿卡姆都受到尊重……直到那天晚上，河流里的东西把路易斯从码头上拖了下去，在水底把他撕成碎片。迈克尔以为当他告诉老大们发生了什么事情的时候，老大们会认为他疯了，但事实更糟：他们告诉他，他们相信并让这件事就这样过去。但迈克尔不能让他拍档的死、或那晚他看到的东西，就这样不了了之。他仍是一位沉默寡言的人。现在他将用他的枪来说话。

flavor: "你，呃……是要去打猎吗？麦克格林先生？"

name: 歌莉娅‧戈德堡
text:
神话阶段期间由你选择调查员顺序。
[reaction]在你查看遭遇牌堆至少1张卡牌时：查看额外1张卡牌并从中选择1张非[[精英]]卡牌。将其丢弃、放到遭遇牌堆顶，或面朝下放置到歌莉娅‧戈德堡底下(在她底下最多3张卡牌)。
[elder_sign]效果：+1。查看遭遇牌堆顶部的卡牌。
back_text: 牌组卡牌张数：30。 次级职阶选择：当牌组构建时，选择守卫者([guardian])、探求者([seeker])或流浪者([rogue])。 牌组构建选项：潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，最多10张你所选次级职阶的等级0-1事件卡和/或技能卡。 牌组构建需求(不计入牌组卡牌张数)：3张心灵感受性、3张末日预言(混洗入遭遇牌堆)、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 在她年幼时，歌莉娅被可怕的幻象所困扰。经过看了多年的医生之后，她学会了透过写故事来忘却这些幻象。她怪异而令人不安的小说不知何故地深入人心，并使她成为一位畅销书作家。但在她拜访阿卡姆时，她经历了有生以来最强烈的幻象。天空被撕裂开来，一只丑陋的怪物凭空涌出。不知道为什么，歌莉娅知道这个幻象是真实的，如果她不做点什么，它就会变成现实。

name: 穷困潦倒

real_text: Revelation - Put Down and Out into play in your threat area. name: 兵法之书

real_text:

name: 行动就绪
text:
只能作为你的第一个行动打出。
从你的手牌打出一张[[枪械]]支援卡，其费用减2。然后，你可以从你的手牌打出一张[[升级]]事件卡，如果可能，将其叠加到该支援卡。

Play a [[Firearm]] asset from your hand, reducing its cost by 2. Then, you may play an [[Upgrade]] event from your hand, attaching it to that asset if able.

name: 爱丽丝‧洛克斯雷
traits: 盟友. 侦探. 警察

如果你成功且超过难度至少1点，获得该花费数量2倍的资源。

name: Arkham Nightlife
text: [reaction] After the last clue is discovered from an [[Arkham]] location: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. One at a time, spawn each [[Criminal]] enemy discarded this way at the nearest empty location.
back_text: Spawn 1 set-aside Gang Enforcer enemy engaged with the investigator with the most clues. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
flavor:
The moon casts long shadows that reach across the ground like searching fingers.
You've always seen this city as home, but tonight Arkham feels like another place entirely.
back_flavor:
Moving quickly down the avenue to your next destination, you see a suspicious-looking woman in a long coat step out from a nearby alley. You turn down a side street to avoid her and nearly run into a man with a wicked scar running down his right cheek. He takes a drag from his cigarette, tosses it to the sidewalk, and glowers at you. You step back only to bump into the woman you saw before. She smiles.
"Where you goin', pal? We just wanna talk."

name: Long Night
text: [reaction] After the last clue is discovered from an [[Arkham]] location: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. One at a time, spawn each [[Criminal]] enemy discarded this way at the nearest empty location.
back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
flavor: Your every step is dogged by both the Sheldons and the O'Bannions. It seems like the two warring gangs have put aside their beef to end your investigation.
back_flavor:
No matter where you go, there seems to be a mobster waiting in every back alley, standing casually on the street corner, or watching from shop windows and park benches. It's too dangerous to continue your search, so you head back to Tillinghast's shop. A mob of gangsters intercepts you just a block away. The largest among them steps toward you menacingly, a lit cigarette clenched in his teeth, as his mooks restrain you.
"Didn't anyone ever tell you that curiosity killed the cat?" He leans down and puts his cigarette out on your cheek, then nods to his lackeys, who swiftly beat you down with brass knuckles, bare fists, and bricks.
Message received.

Not far off, you can see the Cassandra bob on the black waves. It won't be a long trek back to where you made landfall.

Your very bones seem to vibrate with the unceasing thrum of the heart of the city. Pushing panic aside, you press glowing nodes and panels in a futile attempt to drain the chamber, but to no result. Gulping a few last breaths, you dive down, searching for any way out. You just barely squeeze through a massive sluice, struggling against the current. At long last, you tumble out into a deep reservoir filled with icy black water. Below you, the silhouettes of star spawn swim slowly, inexorably toward you. They move without haste, for they know that there is no rush: you have no escape.

text:
Within the ancient vault is a large octagonal room that resembles a kind of laboratory. A central console resembles a clawed hand, with two of its "fingers" raised. Nodes in the console project a glowing translucent letter. Curious, you press one hand to a central node. A vision overwhelmes your mind: a torrential wave, a sundered mountain, burning forests and atmosphere. You pull one hand away, uncertain of what you just experienced. A record? A vision?
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_n] In your Campaign Log, record "Doom" under [tdc_rune_n] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

back_text:
If the investigators control 5 or more Artifact assets:
"I have worked too hard to see my plans undone," Randall seethes. Nightmarish shapes form around the antiquarian's head and shoulders as he grasps at you weakly. Pulse pounding, you run for the shop exit and barrel out into the street. When you turn to look, the shop door has vanished yet again.
(→R1) (page 46).
Otherwise:
"You're too late!" Randall wheezes, clutching his side. "The destruction of Arkham is at hand and you are powerless to stop it." Nightmarish shapes form around the antiquarian's head and shoulders as tchotchkes and ancient tomes fly off the shelves and hang suspended mid-air. Your vision blurs, then you find yourself back on the street. The shop has vanished yet again.
Each investigator earns 1 bonus experience. (→R2) (page 46).

name: The Final Seal
text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, and place an [[Artifact]] asset you control in the victory display: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on your location, as a sigil. Forced - When the enemy phase ends: Draw the top card of the Cthulhu deck. Objective - Banish the awakened dreamer! If each [[Cthulhu]] enemy is in the victory display and there are 5 locations with sigils on them, immediately advance.
back_text: If this agenda advanced by reaching its doom threshold, each investigator is defeated. Otherwise, if there are 5 or fewer [[Ruined]] locations in play, (→R2) (page 50). Otherwise, (→R3) (page 51).
back_flavor:
A quickening gale stirs the black water at Cthulhu's sagging legs. As glowing green sigils alight on the awful dead god's arms and legs, he looses an ear-splitting roar that shatters windows and shakes the very foundations of the city. Hunched over nearby, Andy intones a string of guttural words, holding one shaking hand over a glowing artifact. "It's working!" Ruby shouts.
Another roar. The sound of gunfire echoes across the water as the Arkham police try in vain to draw his attention. You look up to see the ancient one himself staring down at you, his eyes glowing a vivid crimson. The behemoth raises one clawed hand overhead to crush you like an insect.
encounter_name: The Doom of Arkham Part II

name: Colliding Realities
text: Forced - The first time each round an investigator draws a copy of Bleeding Reality: After resolving its effects, that investigators draws the top card of the Reel deck.
back_text: Each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
flavor: Reality continues to warp and bend. It isn't just one film coming to life: all three are blending together in pure chaos.
back_flavor: Whatever strange process was blending and warping realities seems to have ended. Lot C now contains a multitude of horrifying and fantastical worlds. Overhead, a swarm of bats flies under cover of dark storm clouds. A towering brontosaurus shambles out of a steaming prehistoric jungle and out onto a Saturnite landscape. Several extras pursue a hapless director into a silver rocket ship as werewolves howl atop rolling alien dunes. You look around wearily at the once hopeful Hollywood set, now filled with screams and chaos. Lot C is lost.

Find the set-aside André Patel story asset and put it into play under the control of any investigator. He does not take up an ally slot for the remainder of the scenario. Proceed to Interlude: Take Two (page 8).
flavor: The mishaps that have plagued Lot C all seem to stem from several strange props. By tracking them down, you may be able to put a stop to these unfortunate events.
back_flavor: You rejoin André behind one of the film sets. Several accounts blame the recent spate of bad luck on several "cursed" props; two of them, however, seem to be nothing more than mundane items. The third prop, though, has mysteriously disappeared. Together, you and André resolve to search the film set for the missing prop.

She'd only just paid off her new garage when Arkham was devastated by a cataclysmic flood, sending her business quite literally underwater. Daniela knows better than to dismiss these strange happenings as mere circumstance. Whatever it is, she intends to be ready.

Joe isn't sure how each of these events is connected, but he's not about to let the case go cold.

Discard each enemy in play.

flavor: You are searching the dormitories for any sign of your friend.
back_flavor: You find your friend's satchel, scorched with a stylized emblem of an open palm. Wherever your friend is, you imagine they didn't go willingly. As you turn to leave, you are confronted by a masked figure wreathed in flame. As the room erupts into flames around you, they let out a chilling wail.
real_text: Objective - At the end of the round, investigators may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.

name: Escape the Dorms

Discard all tokens and attachments from Your Friend's Room and remove it from the game. Put each remaining set-aside location (Orne Library, Science Hall, Warren Observatory) into play.
flavor: A burning apparition stands between you and the exit. You must escape the dormitories!
back_flavor: You emerge from the dormitories, lungs bursting, into the crisp autumn evening. Looking behind, there is no trace of your pursuer. You remember your friend planned to consult Miskatonic University's head librarian, Dr. Henry Armitage. He may be able to help you understand what is going on.
real_text: Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at Miskatonic Quad, advance. (Hint: Somcetimes it's better to run than to fight!)

Put the set-aside Servant of Flame enemy into play at Miskatonic Quad. Place 3 [per_investigator] clues on Miskatonic Quad. flavor: Your friend had mentioned visiting the head librarian, Dr. Henry Armitage. With more and more strange figures arriving, you must scour the campus for his whereabouts.

You find Dr. Armitage barricaded in one of Orne Library's lecture halls.
"Some on campus have been acting strange lately, your friend among them. But all of that can wait. We must confront your pursuer and stop them before the entire campus burns!" Dr. Armitage says.
real_text: Objective - At the end of the round, investigators at Orne Library may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.

flavor: Your fiery nemesis can't be allowed to hurt more innocents! With Dr. Armitage's help, perhaps you can stop them.

You turn to see a gaggle of terrified students rush past you. When you turn your attention back to your flaming nemesis, they have vanished into thin air.

name: Brethren of Ash
text: Forced - When doom would be placed on a card: Each investigator takes 1 direct damage, instead. Forced - If each remaining investigator is defeated: Advance. Objective - If Elokoss is defeated, (→R1) (page 13).
back_text: Each investigator is killed.
back_flavor:
A knotted, claw-like hand grabs your arm as dozens more wrap around you, embracing you. The touch burns. You scream as a horrifying, toothy maw opens in Elokoss' belly.
"Don't worry. She only wants to honor you," says a familiar voice.
You look behind you to see your friend wearing the same black and red robes as the rest of the Brethren of Ash. They grin at you as tongues of flame billow out from the burning maw, enveloping you in a cocoon of fire. The last thing you hear as you are pulled into the white-hot inferno in Elokoss' chest is your friend - along with the rest of the cult - singing a lilting, off-key hymn for your rebirth.

back_flavor: While he was working with the Boston Police Department, Tommy thought there was no such thing as real monsters. When he got loaned out to the sleepy river town of Arkham, he learned he couldn't have been more wrong. That was almost a year ago at this point, and despite still being "the new guy," he's pretty sure he's seen far more out on the beat than anyone else on the force. Now he's working hard to prove he's not a laughingstock to the rest of the police department, all while facing off against half the monsters of Arkham. And he's learned that not all monsters have fangs and tentacles.
